At the start of the Briefing Phase of the second turn, the Agent may be deployed as normal and in addition has a +1 in one of the following skills: LRC, CRC or the ability to use MARTIAL ARTS Combat cards. Place this card below the Agent to remind you of the increased skill.

name: Safe House
text: Play on any Witness with a skill modifier to permanently add the Keywords EVENT and RESOURCE to the Witness. Thus, the Witness acts as an EVENT, RESOURCE card and remains in play. Place this card below the Witness to remind you of the effect.

name: Samantha Mulder
text: Adds 1 to one Team's SUBTERFUGE skill check once per turn. You may have any number of Samantha Mulder cards in play.

name: Samuel Hartley
text: Play on a Team in the Field that has just had an Agent removed from the game this turn. Make an OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check of 4+. If successful, the Agent remains in play.

name: Section Chief Joseph McGrath
text: Force one Agent (your choice) back to the Bureau immediately. The Agent may not contribute to any skill checks this turn.

name: Semi-Jacketed Hollow Points
text: Play this card on any combatant in a LONG RANGE COMBAT round to add 2 points to that combatant's LRC skill.

name: Senator Richard Matheson
text: Place three tokens on this card. Discard a token to add 2 to one Team's BUREAUCRACY skill check. You may discard a token once per turn. Discard this resource when all tokens have been discarded.

name: Sheriff Daniels
text: Play to change a Site Prerequisite to SUBTERFUGE 3+.

name: Sheriff Mazeroski
text: Negates one GOVERNMENT PAWN

name: Sheriff Spencer
text: Adds 1 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Shotgun
text: Adds 3 to the Agent's LONG RANGE COMBAT skill once per combat. Damage may be split if there are multiple opponents (your choice).

name: Shutting Down The X-Files
text: Play on any Team containing Agent Fox Mulder and/or Agent Dana Scully. Mulder must immediately be moved to the Bureau. Scully must immediately be moved to the Hospital (undamaged). Neither my contribute their skills to skill checks this turn.

name: Sinus Cavity Implant
text: Play on one Agent to decrease the Agent's RES value by one. This card is removed when a Healing card is played on the Agent.

name: Sir Malcolm Marsden
text: Adds 1 to one Team's BUREAUCRACY skill check.

name: Skinner Adopts The Company Line
text: Play whenever Assistant Director Walter Skinner is involved in a skill check. Skinner must go back to the Bureau (if he is not already there) and may not contribute his skills to any skill check this turn.

name: Skinner Chooses A Side
text: Play when Assistant Director Walter Skinner is in the Bureau Section of the table and the AFFILIATION of your opponent's X-File is known. Add the following modifiers to Skinner's skills: +1 BUREAUCRACY, +1 SUBTERFUGE. Skinner is now immune to the "Skinner Adopts The Company Line" card. Place two tokens on this card. Discard a token to negate one Event card. Place this card below Skinner to remind you of the increased skills.

name: Sleep Deprivation
text: Decrease all of the skill levels on one Agent (your choice) by 1 for this turn only.

name: Smoke Screen
text: Play on a Team in the Bureau. If the Team makes a BUREAUCRACY 4+ skill check then designate a Team in the Field. As long as no new members are added to that Team, GOVERNMENT Adversaries may not attack that Team. This card remains in effect until a new Agent is added to the Team.

name: Sneak Attack
text: Play on any EVOLUTIONARY Adversary to allow it to deal all of its damage in the round before its opponents. Any opponents sent to the Hospital as a result of this damage do not cause damage this round.

name: Spin Kick
text: Combatants that can use MARTIAL ARTS may play this card to add 3 to their CLOSE RANGE COMBAT skill this round.

name: Spying Mission
text: Play on any Team. If the Team makes a SUBTERFUGE 4+ skill check, it may use this card to immediately negate any one card that requires them to make a non-combat skill check.

name: Squeeze
text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped.

name: Street Contacts
text: Search through your Bureau Deck and place any one Witness card in your hand. Show the Witness to your opponents. Shuffle the Bureau Deck.

name: Stunning Blow
text: Play this on any opponent who has just taken damage. The opponent is considered "stunned" for the next round of combat. This opponent will deal no damage in the next round of combat.

name: Successful Diagnosis
text: Place on a Team in the Hospital containing an injured Agent. The Agent heals 2 damage immediately.

name: Suppressed Fury
text: Regardless of how much damage is done to this creature in the LONG RANGE COMBAT round, it will attack in the CLOSE RANGE COMBAT round. If its HEALTH has been exceeded, it is removed at the end of the CRC round.

name: Surfing The Net
text: Have a Team make a COMPUTER 4+ skill check. If successful, draw three cards from your chosen opponent's Bureau deck and choose one to place in your Bureau Section face down. Place the other two cards back on top of your opponent's Bureau Deck in any order. You may use the chosen card when appropriate but you must pay the cost. Return the card to its owner's Discard Pile after it has been used. Leave this card on top of the card you've taken from your opponent to remind you that the card you took is considered an EVENT, RESOURCE.

name: Suspect Description
text: Play on a Team that fails a Site skill check when combat was involved. If the Team makes a CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION 3+ skill check, place the Site in the Bureau. At the start of your Briefing Phase, you may place the Site into your hand.

name: Symbol Of Faith
text: OCCULT Adversaries may not assign damage to this Agent unless there are no other eligible targets. If the Agent is the only eligible target then the damage from OCCULT Adversaries is halved.

name: Take Cover!
text: Play this card on any combatant to decrease damage from one LONG RANGE COMBAT source by two points this round.

name: Taped Intelligence
text: Adds 2 to the Agent's BUREAUCRACY skill. GOVERNMENT Adversaries may now attack the Agent's Team when investigating a Site, even when they would otherwise be barred from doing so.

name: Terminal Damage
text: Play on any Agent that has taken 5 or more damage from a single damage source. That Agent must go to the Hospital immediately and may no longer participate in the combat. The Agent cannot leave the Hospital until fully healed. Subtract 5 from the Agent's Cost. If the Cost is zero or less, the Agent is removed from the game. (Agents Lamana, Willis, Purdue and Weiss are immune to this effect.)

name: The Calusari
text: Negates one OCCULT CREATURE.

name: The Cigarette-Smoking Man Strikes
text: Change any Keyword to any other Keyword on a card played by your opponent. This effect lasts until the end of the turn.

name: The Conundrum
text: Play to negate one Keyword EVIDENCE COLLECTION card.

name: The Erlenmeyer Flask
text: Negates any one card played against your Team during a BUREAUCRACY or ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: The Host Attacks
text: Place five tokens on any Agent that loses HEALTH as a result of this creature's attack. Remove a token in each of that Agent's Briefing Phases. At the end of the turn in which the last token is removed, the Agent is removed from the game. This card can be negated by the Team containing the afflicted Agent making a MEDICAL 3+ skill check or by playing a HEALING card on the afflicted player prior to the Agent being removed.

name: The Local Law Enforcement Are Uncooperative
text: Negate one Keyword CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION card.

name: The Lone Gunmen
text: Play "The Lone Gunmen" card on a Site. While played on a Site, The Lone Gunmen are considered a Keyword WITNESS card. A Site with The Lone Gunmen played on it stays in the Field until they are removed. During your Briefing Phase, pay 1 RP to place a token on the Site. When a Team investigates the Site, each token adds 1 to the skill check. Discard The Lone Gunmen after the skill check is resolved.

name: The Manitou Stalks His Prey
text: Any Agent wounded by the Manitou may not heal wounds until a Healing card is successfully played on him.

name: The Mechanic
text: The Mechanic may use MARTIAL ARTS and SUBTERFUGE Combat cards.

name: The Overcoat Man
text: Basic Game Only: Apply a -2 modifier to any one skill check involving one of the following skills: MEDICAL, OBSERVATION, BEHAVIORAL.Advanced Game: Pay the listed [CP] Cost, where X = the number of [CP] paid to gain the desired modifier to one of the following skills: MEDICAL, OBSERVATION, BEHAVIORAL. (1) = -1, (3) = -2, (5) = -3, (9) = -4.

name: The Psychotic Attack
text: Damage from LONG RANGE COMBAT may be split among all opponents (Directed Player's choice).

name: The Sandman
text: The Creature has LONG RANGE COMBAT and CLOSE RANGE COMBAT equal to the highest Combat rating on the opposing team (including modifiers) +1. The Sandman may use SUBTERFUGE Combat cards.

name: The Thinker
text: Change one Keyword to any other one Keyword on a card played by your opponent.

name: The Vampire, A.K.A. The Unholy Spirit
Thorough Documentation

name: Trap
text: Play on a Team in the Field at the start of combat. Force the opponent Team to make an OBSERVATION 4+ skill check. If they fail, the following combat will be fought between the Adversary and one Agent of your choice. No other Agents may participate in the combat.

name: Travel Arrangements
text: You may move one of your Agents to any Section immediately. This card may not be played once an Adversary has forced combat until after the combat is resolved. The Agent may join any Team that occupies the new Section.

name: True Grit
text: Play when an Agent is forced to go to the Hospital. He must still go to the Hospital by the end of this turn but he may add his skills to one skill check before going.

name: Trust No One
text: The Witness's modifier is now changed to a negative (e.g., a +1 becomes a -1). If the Witness has an ability separate from the modifier, this card cancels that ability for this turn.

name: U.S. Marshall Tapia
text: Adds 1 to one Team's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check.

name: Unexplainable Time Loss
text: Force an opponent Team to make a SCIENCES 4+ skill check or the current player's turn ends immediately

name: Unnatural Aging
text: Force the Team to make a SCIENCES 4+ skill check. If they fail, choose one Agent to go to the Hospital. The chosen Agent permanently loses one HEALTH. An Agent's permanent HEALTH can never be reduced below 1.

name: Vicious Fangs
text: Play on any PRIMORDIAL or OCCULT Adversary to add 2 to their CLOSE RANGE COMBAT skill.

name: Walther PPK 7.65 Hold Out Weapon
text: Adds 2 to the Agent's CLOSE RANGE COMBAT skill.

name: Warning From The Loa
text: Force an opponent player to reveal any Adversary cards in his hand. If your opponent has one or more, discard one at random.

name: Warren James Dupré, The Lazarus Man
Watch Out!
text: Play this card when your opponent is about to assign damage. You now choose which of the Agents or Adversaries under your control take the damage. The damage may not be split unless you play a card that allows you to do so.

name: Webbed
text: Play on any PRIMORDIAL Adversary to add 1 to their CLOSE RANGE COMBAT skill and prevent all damage from one opponent this round.

name: Wire-Tap
text: Adds 1 to the Agent's SUBTERFUGE skill.

name: Written Report
text: Play when an Agent is forced to return to the Bureau. Prior to moving, the Team may make a CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION 5+ skill check. If successful, the Agent does not have to return to the Bureau.

name: X
text: Negate any one Keyword ADVERSARY card.

name: X-Files Research

At the start of the Briefing Phase of the second turn, the Agent may be deployed as normal, and in addition has a +1 in one of the following skills: ALIEN INVESTIGATION, OCCULT INVESTIGATION, or SCIENCES. This card may not be played on Agents Mulder or Scully. Place this card below the Agent to remind you of the increased skill.

name: You've Got A Tail
text: Play after a Team investigates a Site to destroy one Event RESOURCE.

name: A Call for Help

Agent Sarah Sheherlis
text: Adds 2 to one Team's SUBTERFUGE or adds 1 to one Team's COMPUTER skill check.

name: Artificially Intelligent Dung-Eating Robotic Probes
text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped. The Probes make one CLOSE RANGE COMBAT attack and are then discarded.

name: Backbreaker
text: Play in CLOSE RANGE COMBAT. Discard a card from your hand to deal additional damage in CLOSE RANGE COMBAT equal to the cost of the discarded card. This damage may be assigned to a different Agent than the one just damaged by the Adversary. X = Cost of the discarded card.

name: Bad Reputation
text: Play this card to force one opponent to discard one Agent card (their choice) from their hand. If they have no Agents, discard one card randomly.

name: Blaine Faulkner
text: Adds 3 to one Team's OBSERVATION or adds 2 to one Team's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check.

name: Bob Spitz

name: Callahan Obstructs Initial Investigation

name: Canvassing
text: Play this card to gain a +1 modifier to the current Site skill check for each Site card discarded from your hand.

name: Carina Sayles
text: Force one opposing Agent of your choice to return to the Bureau. Place two tokens on the Agent. Remove one token during the owning player's Debriefing Phase. When no tokens remain, the Agent may leave the Bureau.

name: Carl Wade
text: Carl Wade engages one opposing Agent (your choice) in Combat. If Wade reduces the Agent to zero HEALTH, discard this card and place the Agent in the Hospital with three tokens on it. Remove one token in each of the owning player's Briefing phases. While tokens are on the Agent, they may not heal damage. When the last token is removed, the Agent may heal damage as normal. This card is considered an ABDUCTION card.

name: Chaos Theory
text: Play this card to change the Site Prerequisite from OCCULT INVESTIGATION to EVIDENCE COLLECTION.

name: Clean-Up Operation
text: You may place up to 2 [RP] from your Resource pool on this card when it comes into play. Discard one [RP] token to double the [CP] Cost of any one Government Adversary played by your opponent. If your opponent cannot or chooses not to pay the additional Cost, the Adversary card is discarded. When no tokens remain on this card, move it to your Discard Pile.

name: Commander Christopher Johansen
text: Adds 3 to one Team's BUREAUCRACY skill check.

name: Cultural Barrier

name: Deforestation

name: Detective Neary
text: Adds 1 to one Team's BUREAUCRACY or CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Diner Cook
text: Adds 2 to one Team's SUBTERFUGE or adds 1 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Disciplinary Actions
text: Play on an opposing Agent. Place three tokens on this card and move the Agent to the Bureau. Remove a token during the opponent's Debriefing Phase. The Agent may not leave the Bureau until all tokens have been removed. While in the Bureau the Agent may not receive or use any equipment; nor may the Agent contribute to any Skill checks.

name: Discovering the Truth
text: Play this card to reveal any face down card by turning it face up (except your opponent's X-File). If it has the Keyword "Secret", it is discarded.

name: Disinformation Campaign
text: Play this card to change the Site Prerequisite from ALIEN INVESTIGATION to CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION.

name: Dr. Carl Roosevelt
text: Adds 2 to one Team's SCIENCES or adds 1 to one Team's COMPUTER skill check.

name: Dr. Lewton
text: Adds 1 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL or BUREAUCRACY skill check.

name: Dr. Richard Godfrey
text: Adds 2 to one Team's OBSERVATION or adds 1 to one Team's MEDICAL skill check.

name: Dr. Seizer
text: Adds 3 to one Team's MEDICAL skill check.

name: Dr. Stroman
text: Play to change a Site Prerequisite to MEDICAL 3+.

name: Dr. Winters
text: Adds 1 to one Team's MEDICAL or SCIENCES skill check.

name: Drag the Lake
text: You may place up to 2 [RP] from your Resource Pool on this card when it comes into play. Discard 1 [RP] token to double the [CP] Cost of any one PRIMORDIAL Adversary played by your opponent. If your opponent cannot or chooses not to pay the additional Cost, the Adversary card is discarded. When no tokens remain on this card, move it to your Discard Pile.

name: Eastpoint State Penitentiary, Leon County, Florida
Falsified Air Force Crash
text: Subtract 4 from one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: FBI Internet Alert
text: You may place up to 2 [RP] from your Resource Pool on this card when it comes into play. Discard 1 [RP] token to double the [CP] Cost of any one EVOLUTIONARY Adversary played by your opponent. If your opponent cannot or chooses not to pay the additional Cost, the Adversary card is discarded. When no tokens remain on this card, move it to your Discard Pile.

name: Foreign Operative
text: This Adversary may use MARTIAL ARTS and SUBTERFUGE cards.

name: Frog Holocaust
text: Negate one Keyword EVOLUTIONARY card.

name: Full Circle to Find the Truth
text: Play this card to give any one Agent OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill equal to their CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill level for the rest of this turn.

name: Galen Muntz
text: Adds 2 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL or adds 1 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Gauthier
text: Adds 1 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or SUBTERFUGE skill check.

name: Government Leaves No Loose Ends
text: Subtract 4 from Team's MEDICAL or SCIENCES skill check.

name: Greetings From Planet Earth
text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite to from MEDICAL to SCIENCES.

name: Hansen's Disease Research Facility, Perkey, West Virginia
Harold Lamb
text: Adds 2 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or adds 1 to one Team's OBSERVATION skill check.

name: He Won't Let Me Die
text: Play this card when an Agent in the Field has been reduced to zero Health and is to be moved to the Hospital or removed from the game. Increase the Agent's Health to 3 (no matter how much damage has been dealt) and leave the Agent in the Field.

name: He's Gonna Find You
text: Play this card to allow Adversaries to attack one Team of Agents anywhere in the Field, Bureau, or Hospital, ignoring Activator requirements.

name: Heroic Leap
text: Place damage tokens, up to one less than the Agent's current health, on an Agent. Apply a +1 modifier to the current Site skill check for each token of damage placed.

name: Hostage Negotiations
text: Play this card on a Team of Agents. Each Combat card discarded from your hand gives the Team a +1 modifier to the Site skill check. X = the number of Combat cards discarded.

name: I'm Not Your Source
text: Play this card in an opponent's Field and place two tokens on it. Discard a token to prevent your opponent from playing any Events or Witnesses while investigating a Site. Does not affect Events or Witnesses currently in play. Discard this card when no tokens remain.

name: I've Got the Tape
text: You may place up to 3 [RP] from your Resource Pool on this card when it comes into play. Discard 1 [RP] token to double the [CP] Cost of any one ALIEN Adversary played by your opponent. If your opponent cannot or chooses not to pay the additional Cost, the Adversary card is discarded. When no tokens remain on this card, move it to your Discard Pile.

name: Implant Records and Steals Memory
text: Play after your opponent has completed a successful Site skill check. Remove up to 4 [RP] from your opponent's Resource Pool.

name: Incanto Stalks Prey Over Internet

name: Informant on the Intelligence Committee

name: Interrogations
text: Place two tokens on this card. Discard one token to double one Witness modifier for the remainder of your turn. This may only be done once per turn. When no tokens remain, move this card to the discard pile.

name: Jennifer Workman
text: Adds 1 to one Team's BUREAUCRACY or COMPUTER skill check.

name: Jeopardizing The X-Files
text: Force one opponent to immediately discard their entire hand. Your opponent, at their option, may opt to pay 3 [RP] for each card they do not want to discard.

name: Jeraldine Kallenchuk
text: Draw the top three cards from your Bureau deck. If any of the drawn cards are playable and contain Keyword CONSPIRACY, you may immediately play one (your choice) for zero [CP] Cost. Discard the remaining cards drawn from your Bureau deck.

name: Jeremiah Smith
text: Adds 3 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or adds 3 to one Team's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check. Alternately, play Jeremiah Smith to immediately heal all damage done to one Agent in the Field. If used in this way, remove this card from the game.

name: Joanne Steffen
text: Adds 1 to one Team's COMPUTER or OBSERVATION skill check.

text: Adds 3 to one Team's EVIDENCE COLLECTION or adds 2 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Kevin Kryder
text: Adds 3 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION or adds 3 to one Team's SUBTERFUGE skill check. Kevin Kryder may contribute either modifier to any skill check in the field during the turn he is played, even other Agent Team skill checks. At the end of your turn, discard this card.

name: Kim Hsin
text: Adds 1 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL or CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Liquid Alien
text: When this card is played on a Team of Agents, they make an ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check of 4+. If successful, discard this card. If not, place this card on an Agent (your choice). That Agent now attacks the Team with the CLOSE RANGE COMBAT, LONG RANGE COMBAT and HEALTH of the Liquid Alien. When Combat ends, the affected Agent is reduced to zero Health.

name: Lobby Guard
text: Adds 2 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or adds 1 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL skill check.

name: Lorraine Kelleher
text: Adds 3 to one Team's SUBTERFUGE or adds 2 one Team's OBSERVATION skill check.

name: Losing Your Tail
text: Play this card at the end of the Case Assignment Phase, after Bluffs have been played. Return any one Site to your hand. Bluffs attached to this Site are moved to the owning player's Discard pile.

name: Lucy Gives Up Her Life For Amy
text: Play this card and choose one Agent to send to the Hospital immediately with zero Health. All Bluff currently affecting that Agent Team (revealed or unrevealed) are discarded.

name: Luis Cardinal
text: Luis Cardinal can attack one Agent (your choice) for one round of LONG RANGE COMBAT and CLOSE RANGE COMBAT. If he attacks Assistant Director Walter Skinner, LRC is skipped and two rounds of CRC take place. If Agent Alex Krycek is attacked, all of his Equipment is removed and discarded.

name: Madam Zirinka
text: Adds 2 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION or adds 1 to one Team's COMPUTER skill check.

text: Play this card on one Site card during the Case Assignment Phase. No Bluffs may be played on this Site except for Bluffs which would negate this card. Discard this card when the Site card is discarded.

name: Making Sacrifices
text: Play this card to allow one Team of Agents to investigate two Sites this turn. In the Debriefing Phase, each Agent takes 2 damage. If this lowers any Agent's HEALTH to zero, move them to the Hospital.

name: Manipulating The Circumstances
text: Play this card to provide the keywords necessary to play any one Adversary. Additionally, the Adversary's cost is halved (rounded up).

name: Menial Assignments
text: Place this card on one opposing Agent. Place three tokens on this card. While this card is in play, the affected Agent may only contribute to Site skill checks using EVIDENCE COLLECTION or CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION as a Prerequisite. Remove on token during your opponent's Debriefing Phase. Discard this card when all tokens have been removed.

name: Mona Wustner
text: Adds 2 to one Team's COMPUTER or adds 1 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Mulder Summer House, Quonochontaug, Rhode Island

name: Señorita Dido, A light in the Darkness
text: Play this card immediately after all Agents in one of your Teams at a Site have been sent to the Hospital. Return the Site card to your hand. Each Agent in that Team immediately heals 1 point of damage.

name: Shared Agony
text: Place this card next to your X-File with three damage tokens on it. Once per turn, during the Healing Phase, you may move one damage token to any one of your opponent’s Agents (your choice). The same Agent may not be damaged on consecutive turns.

name: She is Not Herself
text: Place this card next to your X-File with two tokens on it. Discard a token to apply a -2 modifier to any Agent's Skill Check. You may do this once per turn.

name: The Black Ace
text: Play 3 [CP] to move up to 4 [RP] from your opponent's [RP] pool to your [CP] pool immediately.

name: The Evil Within
text: You may play Keyword BLUFF cards for 1 [CP] less. If placed face down under a Site (as usual), the cost is reduced by 1 more [CP] for a total of 2 [CP] less. A Bluff could be played this way for free, but you can never gain tokens by playing a Bluff card. Your opponent may pay 6 [RP] to force you to discard this card.

name: The Experiment
text: The Experiment engages two opposing Agents (your choice) in Combat.

name: The Jupiter-Saturn Conjunction
text: Force an opponent Team investigating a Site to make a OCCULT INVESTIGATION 4+ skill check or the current player's turn ends immediately.
episode: The Path to the Black Lodge

name: The Log Knows
text: Play this card next to your X-File with three tokens on it. Discard a token to apply a +1 modifier to any one Agent's Skill check. You may do this once per turn.

name: The Man From Another Place
text: Play this card during the Briefing Phase. Discard a Keyword CONSPIRACY card from your hand with a cost of 7 [CP] or less to gain a number of [RP] tokens equal to that card's cost.

name: The Plan Must Be Carried Out
text: Place this card next to your X-File. You may play [RP] Events for one [RP] less. You may only have one of this card in play.

name: The Ultimate Secret
text: Play this card to look at the top six cards of your opponent's Bureau deck. Choose and discard three of them, then return the rest to the top of their deck in any order.

name: The Woodsmen, Sentinels of the Black Lodge
text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped. At the beginning of each combat round you may discard 2 [CP] from your [CP] pool to heal 1 point of damage to the Woodsmen (only 1 damage token can be removed this way each round).

name: To Weak to Matter
text: Play on any Team investigating a Site. Only Agents with a base value of 5 or more [RP] may contribute to that Site skill check.

name: Waldo
text: Adds 3 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or adds 2 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL skill check. If played after Adversary card 'Leland Palmer' attacked a Team, the cost of this card is halved.

name: William Hastings
text: Adds 3 to one Team's SUBTERFUGE or adds 2 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: William Hayward
text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite to Sciences 3+.

name: Windom Earle, Seeker of the Black Lodge
text: If this Adversary's HEALTH is reduced to 0 during Combat, you may immediately play an Adversary card with a cost less than 5 from your discard pile, ignoring Activator requirements, at its normal cost. That Adversary immediately begins a normal Combat with the Team.

name: A war is never over
text: Place this card on Agent Skinner. While Skinner is in the Field, he gains +1 RES and +1 LRC. Each player may have only one of this card in play.

name: Answers to Everything
text: Play this card immediately after incorrectly guessing the identity of your opponent's X-File. You may ask one additional question about the same Characteristic (e.g., RESULT)'. Each player may have only one of this card in their deck. Remove this card from the game.
episode: The Lost Art of Forehead Sweat

name: Arlington National Cemetery, Arlington County, Virginia
Autonomous Hunter
text: This Adversary fights only in LONG RANGE COMBAT rounds. Agents must add their COMPUTER skill to their LRC value (e.g. a COMPUTER skill of 2 and an LRC skill of 1 results in an LRC of 3). Continue LONG RANGE COMBAT rounds until all Agents are defeated or the Adversary's HEALTH reaches zero.

name: Beaumount's Bloodbound Cult
text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT is skipped. When Barbara Beaumont enters play, place one damage token on each Agent in the attacking Team. At the end of each Combat round, after damage has been assigned, Barbara Beaumont heals two damage tokens for each Agent defeated that round, but only if her HEALTH is still above 0.

name: Classified Experiments
text: Play after one of your Teams successfully investigated a Site with Alien Investigation skill as a prerequisite. Add 7 [RP] to your pool.

name: Commander Al's Covert Mission
text: Damage caused by this Adversary may be split among all opponents (Directed Player's choice). This Adversary may use MARTIAL ARTS Combat cards.

name: DNA Vision Goggles
text: Adds 2 to the Agent's MEDICAL and SCIENCES skills. You cannot sell this card during the Briefing phase to gain [CP] points.

name: Double Trouble: Plus One
text: This Adversary is an exact copy of any Agent card in the Team investigating this Site (your choice) and will engage in Combat only with that Agent. Follow normal Combat rules until one of the Agents (or both) reaches a HEALTH value of zero.

name: Dr. Augustus Goldman
text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite to SCIENCES 3+.

name: Dr. Karah Hamby
text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite to COMPUTER 3+.

name: Erika Price
text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite to BUREAUCRACY 3+. Your opponent may pay 3 [CP] to negate this Witness.

name: Goop-O A-B-C
text: Discard this card to add two to any of the Agent's skills. You can have only one of this card in your deck.
episode: The Lost Art of Forehead Sweat

name: Guy Mann
text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite to SUBTERFUGE 3+.
episode: Mulder and Scully Meet the Were-Monster

name: High Frequency Wave
text: The High Frequency Wave is unaffected by Combat attacks. It will attack once in one LONG RANGE COMBAT round and one CLOSE RANGE COMBAT round, then it is discarded.

name: Immunity for Loyalty
text: Attach this card to any Agent in the Team investigating this Site. Each time this Agent contributes to a skill check, you must place a damage token on them. Remove this card when the Agent is sent to the Hospital with zero HEALTH. Only one of this card may be in play at a time.

name: Kitten's Revenge
text: The chosen Agent is the only one who may participate in Combat. The Kitten's Revenge may use SUBTERFUGE cards. If he attacks Assistant Director Walter Skinner, LRC is skipped.

name: Langly's Afterlife
text: Force up to two face-down Bluff cards attached to one or different Sites to be discarded .

name: Magical Mystery Tour
text: Decrease all of the skills levels on one Agent (your choice) by 2 for this turn only. Then, regardless of whether the Site Prerequisite is met or not, move the Agent to the Hospital with one damage token.

name: Mr. Chuckle Teeth
text: When you play Mr. Chuckleteeth, your opponent must choose two Agents. Send all other Agents are sent to the Hospital with zero HEALTH. Then, discard this Adversary.

name: Mr. Green
text: Mr. Green may use MARTIAL ARTS and SUBTERFUGE cards. Each Agent wounded by Mr. Green may not contribute to any skill check this turn.

name: Mr. Y's Loyal Servant
text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT is skipped. This Adversary may attack a Team of Agents in the Bureau. During the Combat, the Bureau is considered to have a single Characteristic SITE Keyword. You may choose any one (e.g., RESULT SITE) and play this Adversary in the Bureau instead, following the usual Combat rules.

name: Mr. Y's Manipulation
text: Play this card on a MULTI Site card. If the Team successfully investigates the Site after meeting the Site Prerequisite, you may choose the type of question your opponent may ask from the options listed on the Site card.

name: No one is safe
text: For the remainder of this turn, a Site in the Field (your choice) is considered to have a single Characteristic Characteristic SITE Keyword. You may choose any one Characteristic for the Keyword (i.e., RESULT SITE).

name: No Witness Left
text: Place this card on your opponent's Field. If your opponent plays an Agent or Witness card from their hand, that card is abducted and placed under this one. On their next turn, your opponent may play the abducted card as usual at no cost. Then, discard this card.

name: Pillow Talk
text: Play this card immediately after a Witness card is played. Double the skill value provided by the Witness for the current skill check (i.e.: a Witness with COMPUTER +2 becomes COMPUTER +4).
episode: Mulder and Scully Meet the Were-Monster

name: Protector's Charm
text: When this card enters play, choose one Adversary Keyword (i.e.: ALIEN). Adversaries with chosen Keyword may not deal any damage to this Agent. If the Agent is the only eligible target, the damage is halved.

name: Quid Pro Quo
text: If the Team investigating this Site successfully meets the Site Prerequisite, you must reveal one of your X-File's characteristics to your opponent (their choice), and your opponent must reveal the same characteristic to you. Remove this card from play. You may only have one of this card in your deck.

name: Roswell Cover Up
text: Play this card during the Briefing phase. Force the Active player to remove one [RP] card already in play with the Keyword SITE, EQUIPMENT or RESOURCE from their side of the game (their choice). Then, search your opponent Discard Pile and remove one card of your choice from the game.

name: Sheriff Mac Stenzler
text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite to OBSERVATION 3+. Your opponent may pay 3 [CP] to negate this Witness.

name: Sister in Arms
text: You play an Agent card from your hand at no cost (tokens included). The Agent cannot investigate any Site, but you may use their game effect. At the end of your turn, remove this card and the Agent from the game.

name: Smart Phone
text: Discard this card to search through your Bureau deck for a Witness card. Shuffle your deck, and immediately play the Witness card at no cost.

name: Sveta Zatylny
text: Adds 2 to one Agent's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check. Your opponent may pay 3 [CP] to negate this Witness.

name: Tad O'Malley'
text: Adds 3 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or adds 2 to one Team's BUREAUCRACY skill check.

name: The Band-Aid Nose Man
text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped. This Adversary can only attack Teams that consist of a single Agent, including Teams that originally had more Agents but were reduced to one after a Combat.

name: The Mandela Effect
text: When a team of Agents contributes to a single skill check this turn, they use the following swapped skills: ALIEN INVESTIGATION ↔ BUREAUCRACY, BEHAVIORAL ↔ OCCULT INVESTIGATION, COMPUTER ↔ SCIENCES, OBSERVATION ↔ MEDICAL. If a skill is missing, its value is 0. Remove this card from play.
episode: The Lost Art of Forehead Sweat

name: The System is Watching
text: Play this card to examine your opponent's hand. Select one Active card. If your opponent plays that card this turn, subtract 4 points from their Team's Site skill check.

name: This Never Happened
text: Play this card to force the investigating player to discard their entire hand.

name: Where is Walter Skinner?
text: Play this card to allow Assistant Director Walter Skinner to leave the Bureau and join any Team in the Field, unless an Adversary has already forced combat. During your Debriefing Phase, if Skinner remains in the Field, you may move him back to the Bureau.

name: You see what I want you to see
text: Discard two cards at random from your hand to negate any [CP] card played by your opponent. Each player may only have one of this card in their deck.

name: A Final Choice
text: Play this card to immediately move one opposing Agent to the Hospital. Place this card beneath the Agent and place five tokens on the Agent (seven tokens if played on Agent Mulder). Remove a token during the Agent's Healing Phase. When all tokens have been removed, discard this card. The Agent may leave the Hospital when all tokens have been removed.

name: Alien Technology
text: Play after one of your Teams successfully investigates a Site with ALIEN INVESTIGATION or BUREAUCRACY skill as a prerequisite. Place this card in your Bureau. Discard this card to negate one ALIEN or GOVERNMENT Adversary.

name: Believe The Lie
text: Exchange your X-File with ALIEN Affiliation with any X-File with GOVERNMENT Affiliation.

name: Blue Plate Special
text: Play this card and flip over the next card on your Bureau Deck. If that card is playable this turn you may do so for zero [RP] or [CP]. If you do not play it this turn, move the card to your discard pile.

name: Call On Us More Often
text: Play this card to search through your Bureau Deck and add one of the following cards to your hand: No One So Paranoid, The Lone Gunmen, Langly, Frohike, or Byers. If you play the chosen card immediately, you may do so for half Cost (round up).

name: Chester Bonaparte, The Spirit Guide
text: Negate one OCCULT Adversary. In addition, if the Team makes an OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check of 6+, they may ask either one METHOD question or one RESULT question.

name: Deny Everything
text: Play this card immediately after your opponent asks you a question. You may respond with this phrase: "I can neither confirm nor deny that assumption." After playing this card remove it from the game.

name: Die Hand Die Verletzt
text: Spielen Sie diese Karte zum Durchsuchen Ihres Büro Stapels. Dann wählen Sie einen OCCULT Gegner, mit dem Sie automatisch den AgentenTeam zur Ortserkundung angehören. Der OCCULT Gegner kann anstatt der 0 [CP] gespielt werden, unter Mißachtung der Aktivierungs-Anforderungen.English Translation: You may search your Bureau deck and take any Occult Creature and you may play it on the agents team making the skill check. You may play it at any site. (Meaning you can play an Adversary with Activator Affiliation on a Motive, Method, or Result site as well.) This costs 0 [CP].

name: Fighter Interceptor
text: Negates an Alien Adversary.

name: Good Fortune
text: Once this card is played, only the Investigating player may play Events while investigating this Site, except for Events which would negate this card. Discard this card when the Site is discarded.

name: Infected That You Might Believe
text: Play this card and place it beneath one Agent to lower all of that Agent's skill levels by 1. This cannot result in a skill being negative or permanent Health being less than 1. When played on Agent Dana Scully, the conspiracy player may choose to force Scully to spend every other turn in the Hospital (if this option is chosen, Scully's skills are not reduced). This choice must be made when the card is played and cannot be changed later. Healing cards will negate this card.

name: Je Vois Quelque Chose La Au-Dessous
text: Recherchez dans votre paquet de cartes FBI et choisissez une carte ALIEN Mot-clé ou ALIEN INVESTIGATION. Montrez cette carte à votre adversaire, ajoutez-la à votre jeu et mélangez le paquet de cartes FBI.English Translation: Search your Bureau deck and choose one keyword ALIEN or ALIEN INVESTIGATION card. Show this card to your opponent, add it to your hand and shuffle your Bureau deck.

name: Mulligan
text: Discard your entire hand and draw seven cards from the top of your Bureau Deck.

name: No One So Paranoid
text: Play this card to gain one of the following: Adds +1 to Computer skill, negates one Event, or discard one Bluff card from a site.

name: Not On The Menu
text: Draw 2 cards from the top of your Bureau deck and add them to your hand.

name: Smoke and Mirrors (v1)
text: Apply a +1 modifier to any skill check.

name: Smoke and Mirrors (v2)
text: Apply a -1 modifier to any skill check.

name: Smoke and Mirrors (v3)
text: Apply a +2 modifier to any one opponent skill check.

name: Smoke and Mirrors (v4)
text: Apply a -2 modifier to any one opponent skill check

name: Smoke and Mirrors (v5)
text: Apply a +3 or -3 (your choice) modifier to any skill check.

name: Teamwork
text: Play this card on any Team consisting of no more than two Agents during the Investigation Phase when they are sent to investigate a Site. You may add a number of tokens to the [RP] pool equal to the Agents' total RES value.

name: The Dark Angel
text: The Dark Angel can play all combat cards for one [CP] less.

name: A Bit of Light
text: Play on an Agent to allow that Agent to use their EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill number for any CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION Or BEHAVIORAL skill check.

name: A Privileged Mind
text: Play this card to look at the top three cards of your Bureau deck. Then, you may place them back in any order.

name: Adam Pierce
text: Adds 3 to one Team's SCIENCES or adds 2 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Adversary's Rebirth
text: Play this card on an Evolutionary Adversary immediately after the Combat has ended, when that Adversary played is sent to the Discard Pile. You can start another Combat with the same Adversary for half cost (rounded up) against the same Team of Agents.

name: Agent Krycek, Killed by Skinner
text: If your opponent includes Agent Krycek in any skill check in the Field, Agent Krycek is instantly killed and removed from the game.

name: Agent Medical Escort
text: One Agent (your choice) may immediately "escort" another Agent in the same Team if forced to go to the Hospital (only if chosen Agent is not required to go to the Hospital too). The escorted Agent may remove three additional points of damage while being accompanied during the next healing phase.

name: Agent Monica Reyes at Death's Door
text: If your opponent includes Agent Monica Reyes in any skill check in the Field, the Agent is instantly killed and removed from the game. Your opponent may play the card Audrey Pauley to negate the effects of this card. Agent Monica Reyes takes no damage and Audrey Pauley is killed instead. Remove the Witness card from the game, whether it was already in play or not.

name: Agent on Demand
text: Search through your Bureau Deck and select an Agent with a Cost of 3 or less [RP] (X), and place it in the Bureau section with this card attached. If this card is negated, remove it as well as the selected Agent from the game. During the Briefing Phase, pay X [RP] upkeep or discard this card and the selected Agent. Ignore the Agent's Game Effect.

name: Agent Pathogen Treatment
text: Play this card to negate any Keyword ALIEN MANIPULATION card or to heal 1 point of damage on any Agent in the Hospital.

name: Agent's Verschwinden
text: Select one Agent from the Team investigating this Site. That Agent, along with any cards attached beneath it, is placed face up twelve cards down into the owning player's Bureau deck. When the Agent card reaches the top of the deck, the Agent and all cards attached to it are immediately deployed to the Field (undamaged).

name: Agents' Recharge
text: Play this card at the beginning of the Case Assignment or the Investigation Phases to get an additional Healing phase this turn. After that extra phase, go directly to the Debriefing phase. Remove this card from the game.

name: Alfred Fellig
text: Adds 2 to the Agent's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check. Alternately, any card that would send Dana Scully to the Hospital may be negated by playing this card. If played this way, remove Alfred Fellig from the game. This card cannot be played during a Combat and it is not a Healing card.

name: Alien Abduction
text: Force a Team in the Field to make an ALIEN INVESTIGATION 4+ skill check. If they fail, attach this card to any Agent in that Team (your choice) and remove the Agent from play. During the next Agent's controller Healing phase, move the Agent to the Hospital (undamaged).

name: Alien DNA Drain
text: You may discard any number of cards from your hand to force your opponent to discard the same cards from their hand (opponent's choice).

name: Alien Relic Unveiled
text: Play on one Agent to allow that Agent to use their EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill number for any one ALIEN INVESTIGATION or SCIENCES skill check.

name: Alien Spider Host
text: Attach the Alien Spider to an Agent in a Team of two or more Agents. That Agent becomes aggressive and attacks their own Team sequentially, one by one (your choice). Then the infected Agent moves on to the next Agent, until all Agents are defeated or until he is sent to the Hospital. Discard this card afterwards.

name: All Lies Lead to the Truth
text: Place this card in one of your opponents Fields. Your opponent must subtract 1 from the [CP] he generates each turn while this card is in his Field. Your opponent may pay 5 [CP] to force you to discard this card.

name: Alvin Kurtzweil
text: Adds 1 [RP] to your pool every time a Keyword BUREAUCRACY or GOVERNMENT card is played.

name: Ammunition Reload
text: Play this card on any Agent during a LONG RANGE COMBAT round to double that Agent's LRC skill. This effect must be applied before any other modifier and only over the LRC listed on that Agent's card.

name: Animated Snakes
text: Play this card for 2 [CP] less if played on a Site card with the Keyword OCCULT INVESTIGATION.

name: Apology is Policy
text: Play this card to change a negative skill check modifier to a positive one (e.g., a -1 becomes a +1).

name: Arthur Dales
text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite to CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION 3+.

name: Ashen Whispers
text: Play this card on any Agent in a Team including Agent Charles Burk to use that Agent's COMPUTER skill number for any one EVIDENCE COLLECTION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Astral Alignment Anomaly
text: Attach this card to any Agent at the moment a Game Effect token is about to be removed from that Agent. That token is removed without applying its effect. Remove all remaining Game Effect tokens from that Agent. While this card is in play, that Agent cannot receive any Game Effect tokens. Each player may only have one of this card in their deck.

name: Audrey Pauley
text: Adds 2 to one Team's OBSERVATION or adds 1 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check, or play this card when one of your Agents must go to the Hospital with zero HEALTH to remove half of the damage tokens (rounded up). The Agent must still go to the Hospital.

name: B.A.T.F. Reinforcements
text: Play this card on target Team during a Combat to get an extra combatant in that Team with following skills: LRC: 3, CRC: 2, HEALTH: 5. Discard this card after the Combat phase has ended.

name: Backheld
text: Play this card on any combatant in a CLOSE RANGE COMBAT round to reduce the damage from any one source by one point.

name: Battle Expertise
text: Target Agent or Adversary gains an extra LRC/CRC bonus skill equal to the number of Combat cards in your Discard pile.

name: Believe to Understand
text: Force an opponent Team investigating a Site to make a ALIEN INVESTIGATION 4+ skill check or the current player's turn ends immediately.

name: Beth Kane
text: Adds 3 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION or adds 2 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Betty Templeton
text: This You may search your Bureau deck for the "Lulu Pfeiffer" Adversary card and play it immediately, ignoring Activator requirements. If you do, both Adversaries attack simultaneously (treat as one Combat). Double both cards' CRC and HEALTH, and skip the LONG RANGE COMBAT round.

name: Billy Miles, Resurrected
text: This card does not initiate combat. Move up to two Agents in the Team investigating this site (your choice) to the Hospital with zero HEALTH. The Agent(s) may not leave the Hospital until fully healed. Combat cards cannot be used against this Adversary.

name: Bio-medical Division Card
text: Discard this card to change the Site Prerequisite to MEDICAL or SUBTERFUGE in a Site investigated by the Agent equipped with this card. Keywords of the Site card are also changed.

name: Biochip Implant
text: Attach this card to any Agent in the Field to reduce their HEALTH by one. Opponents may play ALIEN MANIPULATION cards that affect that Agent at half cost (rounded up). Discard this card if the Agent visits the Hospital or if the Team he belongs makes a successful MEDICAL or SCIENCES +7 skill check.

name: Biohazard Protection Suit
text: Adds 1 to the Agent's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill. Agents equipped with this card are not affected by ALIEN MANIPULATION cards. Additionally, you can discard this card to add one to the Agent's SCIENCES skill.

name: Blazing Pages
text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite to OCCULT INVESTIGATION 3+.

name: Blevins' Inquiry
text: Force one Agent with the Keyword SKEPTIC (your choice) to go back to the Bureau immediately. The Agent may not contribute to any skill checks this turn.

name: Blinding Predator
text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped. Target Agent (your choice) in the Team attacked by the Blinding Predator receives a poisonous attack and is considered "blinded" for the first CLOSE RANGE COMBAT round. That Agent will deal no damage during that round of combat.

name: Briefed on Secrets
text: Discard an Equipment card in play (your choice).

name: Bruckman's Foretelling
text: During the Briefing Phase, place a token on Clyde Bruckman's card only once the starting token has been removed. This token is usable in the same way as the starting token. Remove this card from the game.

name: Burning Loyalties
text: Play this card to negate one Witness RESOURCE immediately or to prevent the investigating player from playing any Witnesses while investigating this Site, except for Witnesses which would specifically negate this card.

name: Caballero, Memory Vampire
text: This card does not initiate combat. Play this card in your Field section. Place two tokens on this card. Discard a token anytime to look at the top three cards of your opponent's Bureau deck or to avoid an Agent to heal damage tokens during the Healing phase. When no tokens remain, move this card to the discard pile.

name: Cassandra Spender
text: Adds zero to one Team's BUREAUCRACY or ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check. If this card is used in a successful Site investigation, the owning player may ask "Is your X-File's Affiliation Alien?" in addition to the Site question for zero cost.

name: Cerulean Hunt
text: You can change up to two cards from your hand with a similar number of Bluffs that you have already played on a Site and are still in play (face down). The new Bluffs under the Site can still be negated.

name: Charles Wesley Gotts
text: Play this card to provide the keywords necessary to play any one Keyword PAWN Adversary.

name: ChemElement Analyzer
text: Agents equipped with a ChemElement Analyzer have access to the field office crime lab. Adds 1 to the Agent's SCIENCES and SUBTERFUGE skills.

name: Chrissy Giorgio
text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite to ALIEN INVESTIGATION 3+.

name: Christmas Retreat
text: You may take a second purchase of cards after your first one (during the Briefing Phase). Then, go directly to the Case Assignment phase. Remove this card from the game. The effects of this card cannot be negated.

name: Chuck Forsch
text: Adds 2 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION Or adds 1 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL skill check.

name: Chung's Cosmic Goliath
text: This card does not initiate Combat. Pick one Agent from an investigating Team. That Agent remains "confused" until end of turn and cannot contribute his or her skills to any Site skill check.

name: Cocoon
text: Play this card to return target Equipment card to the owner's hand.

name: Covering the Killer
text: Play this card on a Team investigating a Site to increase that Site Prerequisite by two.

name: Covering up Evidence
text: Play this card to return one Keyword RESOURCE card to the owner's hand.

name: Cradock Marine Bank, 8th St, Washington D.C.
Critical Countdown
text: If your opponent plays any card on this Site, it will automatically cause two points of damage to every Agent in a Team investigating the Site. If you play any card, empty your [CP] pool afterwards.

name: Cross-team Support
text: Play this card to allow one Agent on a Team in the Field to add their skills to one skill check that is occurring in another Site in the Field being investigated by another Team. The Agent's skill is reduced by 1 (i.e., Skill: 2 becomes Skill: 1). LRC and CRC may not be added.

name: Cult Carnage
text: Play this card on a Team in the Field that plays a Witness during the Investigation phase. The Witness card is discarded. Instead, that Witness joins the Temple of the Seven Stars and will attack one of the Agents in that Team (your choice) only during an LRC round.

name: Danielle Manley
text: Adds 3 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or adds 2 to one Team's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check.

name: Dark Dealings
text: Subtract 4 from one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION or SUBTERFUGE skill check.

name: Dead Zone
text: Place this card in any Section of your opponent's side of the table. While this card is in play, no Agent in that Section may contribute their skills to skill checks in another Section of the table. The player controlling this Section may pay 4 [RP] to discard this card.

name: Deal Master
text: Play this card during the Briefing Phase. The next [RP] card you discard this turn will generate twice as many [CP] tokens as its [RP] cost.

name: Deceive, Inveigle, Obfuscate
text: Play this card to add or decrease by two any Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check.

name: Deceptive Visions
text: During this turn, you may change the BELIEVER, SKEPTIC, or NEUTRAL keyword of any one Agent in play to another of these keywords. If the Agent does not already have one of these keywords, you may add one of them to the Agent.

name: Deep Throat
text: Ask any one Characteristic question regarding one opponent's X-File. Remove this card from the game. The effects of this card may not be negated.

name: Deep Throat's Demise
text: Play this card to empty both player's pools ([RP] and [CP]).

name: Demonic Puppet
text: The Demonic Puppet initiates Combat but does not assign nor receive any damage. Instead, the selected Agent in a Team inflicts a wound upon himself or herself equal to the sum of their LRC & CRC values, applied only once. Healing cards may be used to prevent damage, including any Combat cards that do not modify LRC and/or CRC.

name: Deny Everything
text: Play this card immediately after your opponent asks you a question. You may respond with this phrase: "I can neither confirm nor deny that assumption." After playing this card remove it from the game.

name: Die Wahrheit ist irgendwo da draußen
text: Play this card to force an opponent Team currently investigating a Site to make a SUBTERFUGE 4+ skill check. If they fail only Agents with the Keyword FBI may contribute their skills to any skill check made on this Site.

name: Dio Ti Ama
text: Place this card in your field. The cost of all [RP] cards you play this turn is halved (rounded up). Discard this card at the end of this turn. Each player may only have one of this card in their deck.

name: Distracting Vision
text: Pick the top 5 cards from your Bureau deck and show them to your opponent. You may play one revealed Bluff card at half cost (rounded up), if any. Shuffle the rest back into your Bureau deck.

name: Doctor Lorenz
text: Adds 3 to one Team's MEDICAL or adds 2 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL skill check.

name: Donnie's Deadly Game
text: This card can only be played during the Case Assignment Phase to return a Site card played by your opponent back to their hand.

name: Doppelganger Agent
text: Play this card at the beginning of the Briefing Phase. Remove target Agent from play (Equipment and tokens included) and replace it with this card, representing a doppelganger with all skills reduced by one. Owner may use the Agent normally. At the end of the turn, discard this card and return the original Agent.

name: Double Agent
text: Play this card at the end of the Briefing Phase to move any number of tokens from your [RP] pool to your [CP] pool or vice versa. Each player may only have one of this card in their deck. Remove this card from the game.

name: Dr. Simon Bruin
text: Adds 1 [RP] to your pool every time a Keyword SCIENCES or EVOLUTIONARY card is played.

name: Drowned Resources
text: Play this card to discard all Keyword RESOURCE cards in play.

name: E pur si muove
text: Both players must discard their entire hands and draw seven cards from the top of their respective Bureau Decks.

name: Edge of the Unknown
text: Place this card next to your X-File. You may draw one card for free in each of your opponents' Briefing Phases. You may only have one of this card in play.

name: Electric Anomalies
text: All Agents in a Team must discard all attached Keyword ELECTRICAL Equipment immediately.

name: Electro-Chemical Link
text: Attach this card to an Agent you control and place two tokens on it. During each Briefing Phase, remove one token to add +2 to that Agent's RES value. Discard this card when all tokens are removed.

name: Ellen Adderly
text: The chosen Agent is the only one who may participate in the Combat. This card is free and Activator requirements are ignored if it is played on a Keyword OCCULT INVESTIGATION Site.

name: Eluding the Oubliette
text: Play this card to remove one token from any Bluff card that forces an Agent to remain in any section (or be removed from the game) for each 3 [RP] spent. (i.e.: if 6 [RP] are paid, you may remove 2 tokens).

name: Elusive Fugitive
text: Play on any PAWN or PRIMORDIAL Adversary to negate all damage allocated to that Adversary this round.

name: Elusive Informant
text: Play this card to add or decrease by two any Team's BUREAUCRACY or ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Emergency Admission
text: Place this card in the Hospital. Once per turn, during the Healing phase, you can remove from play a card from your hand to heal one point of damage to an Agent in the Hospital.

name: Emergency Evacuation
text: Play this card at the end of any Combat round to allow up to two Agents in that Team to leave the Combat if their HEALTH was not reduced to zero yet. Both Agents may still contribute their skills to other skill checks and be moved to the Hospital this turn.

name: Emergency Quarantine
text: Place this card in the Field. You can avoid an attack of an Adversary played by your opponent by placing it under this card. It will attack on the next Site you play ignoring any activators. Discard this card afterwards.

name: Emily
text: Apply a +1 modifier to any one skill check made by a Team of Agents in the Field during the Investigation phase.

name: Erwin Lukesh
text: Play this card on a team of Agents. The Agents in that team cannot deliver any damage to Erwin Lukesh during the LONG RANGE COMBAT round unless they have OBSERVATION or SUBTERFUGE skills. Erwin Lukesh may use SUBTERFUGE cards.

name: Esther Nairn
text: Play this card to negate the Adversary card 'Kill Switch'. Alternatively, you can attach Esther Nairn to any Agent in the Field to add 1 to that Agent's COMPUTER skill once per tur while the Agent is in the Field. Discard Esther Nairn when the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to 0.

name: Evasive Adversary
text: Play on any PRIMORDIAL Adversary to reduce damage from all opponent LONG RANGE COMBAT or CLOSE RANGE COMBAT sources by 1 this round.

name: Everything Dies
text: Place this card in the Field. As long as this card is in play, any Agent whose HEALTH value is reduced to zero is instantly killed and removed from the game. If any player loses all their Agents, that player loses the game.

name: Eyes of Obedience
text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite from CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION to OCCULT INVESTIGATION.

name: Face Mask
text: Adds two to the Agent's HEALTH.

text: Subtract 4 from one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Fateful Omen
text: Remove from play any Agent with the Keyword FBI in a Team investigating this Site. The Agent may not contribute their skills to any check this turn. Move the Agent back to the Field during the next Briefing Phase.

name: Father Joseph Crissman

text: Place this Equipment card in the Bureau section. Once per turn, any Agent in the Bureau may add their COMPUTER or CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skills to any skill check done by any Team in the Field.

name: FBI Credentialed
text: Play this card to add the Keyword FBI to any Agent in play (your choice) until the end of the turn.

name: FBI Crossroads
text: Play this card during a LONG RANGE COMBAT round on a combatant you control with a LRC skill. That combatant and one other combatant of the owning player's choice will deal no damage in this LRC round. Additionally, reduce any combatant's HEALTH by two during the Combat.

name: FBI King County Crime Lab, Seattle
FBI Raid

text: Once per turn you can pay 4 [RP] to recruit an FBI cadet Agent. Use a token to represent this Agent that can be used to join a Team using these skills: LRC: +2, CRC:+2 and HEALTH: 3. name: FBI Reinforcement

name: Hand Bind
text: Play this card during a CLOSE RANGE COMBAT round on any Adversary with the Keyword PRIMORDIAL or that is capable of using MARTIAL ARTS cards. The Adversary may bind an Agent (your choice), preventing that Agent from dealing damage during the remaining CRC rounds.

text: Adds 1 to the Agent's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill. Additionally, you can discard this card to add two to the Agent's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill.

text: Play on one Agent to allow that Agent to use their EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill number for any one ALIEN INVESTIGATION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Identity Intrusion
text: Play this card to gain control of an Agent during a single Combat round (your choice).

name: Identity Swap
text: Play this card at the beginning of the Briefing Phase. Swap one of your Agents with an opponent's Agent of equal or lower cost in the same section (include tokens and attached cards). Players may not control duplicate Agents, and the Game Effect of the swapped Agents cannot be used. At the end of the turn, return both Agents to their final locations (sections).

name: In Deep Shadows
text: Play this card to negate search through your Bureau Deck and add one of the following cards to your hand: 'The End', 'Second's Elder Deliberation', 'Covering Up Evidence', or 'The Toothpick Man'. name: Jesse Landis
text: Adds 3 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL or adds 2 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check. If played after Adversary card "2Shy" attacked a Team, the cost of this card is halved.

text: This card does not initiate combat. Place this card face up in your opponent's Bureau deck and reshuffle the deck. This card has no effect if it reaches the top of the deck during your opponent's turn as Directed player.

name: Kallencheck's Salvage Brokers, San Francisco, CA
Karin's Dark Sorcery
text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped. For each Agent that Karin's Dark Sorcery sends to the Hospital you may remove up to 4 [RP] from your opponent's Resource Pool.

name: Kill Switch
text: The Kill Switch creates a distorted reality on the Team of Agents, dealing a total of 5 damage points, split among any number of opposing Agents (Directed Player's choice). For each chosen Agent, subtract their COMPUTER skill from the assigned damage - damage cannot be reduced below 0.

name: Knowle Rohrer
text: Knowle Rohrer regenerates (heals) one point of HEALTH at the beginning of each combat round as long as his HEALTH is not at zero.

name: Krycek's Amputation
text: Play on Agent Krycek when he is in the Field and is involved in an ALIEN INVESTIGATION or BUREAUCRACY skill check. Krycek loses his right arm and all his skills are halved (rounded up). This card cannot be negated and remains attached to Krycek until the end of the game.

name: Krycek's Deadly Ultimatum
text: Play this card to force any opponent to skip the Healing phase.

name: Langly
text: Negate any one Bluff card.

name: Lasioderma Serricorne Outbreak
text: This card does not initiate Combat. Place target Agent under this card. The Agent may not contribute to any skill check this turn nor generate RES while under this card. At the beginning of your opponent's next Healing phase, remove this card from the game and send the Agent to the Hospital with two damage tokens.

name: Last Dial Inquiry
text: Discard a card from your hand. During your next Briefing Phase, draw two additional cards (in addition to the one you would normally draw). Ignore the effects of any card that prevents you from doing so.

name: Letter From Samantha
text: Play this card on a Team of Agents. If the Team makes an ALIEN INVESTIGATION Skill check 5+, look through any player's Bureau deck and remove any one card from the game. Shuffle that Bureau deck afterwards. You may only have one of this card in your Bureau Deck.

name: Life From Ashes
text: Play this card to heal all damage done to an Agent only if their HEALTH is reduced to zero after a Combat. The Agent can still contribute with their skills to the Site skill check this turn.

name: Limited Choices
text: Play this card to cause the Investigating player to discard X number of cards (chosen randomly) from his hand. X = [CP] cost paid.

name: Linda Bowman

name: Lone No More
text: Negate one of these cards (your choice): 'Byers', 'Frohike', 'Langly', 'Call on us more often', 'No one so paranoid', 'Three words, one solution', 'The Lone Gunman', 'The Lone Gunmen' or 'Three of a kind'.

name: Long-Range Combat Training
text: Play on an Agent in the Bureau. The Agent is taken out of play for one full turn. At the start of the Briefing Phase of the second turn, the Agent may be deployed as normal and in addition has a +2 in LRC skill. Place this card below the Agent to remind you of the increased skill.

name: Lord of the Flies
text: At the beginning of each combat round, you may choose one Agent. That Agent is webbed and cannot attack or use abilities that round. If that Agent's HEALTH is reduced to 0 by the end of the Combat, you may draw one extra card at the start of your next Briefing Phase.

name: Lucky Keyword Unlock
text: Play on one Team in the Field. If the Team makes a COMPUTER skill check 5+, then they may add 2 to any Site skill check. Discard this card after you have used the modifier.

name: Lulu Pfeiffer
text: This You may search your Bureau deck for the "Betty Templeton" Adversary card and play it immediately, ignoring Activator requirements. If you do, both Adversaries attack simultaneously (treat as one Combat). Double both cards' CRC and HEALTH, and skip the LONG RANGE COMBAT round.

name: Maitreya's Virtual Menace
text: Maitreya may use MARTIAL ARTS Combat cards. The damage dealt by her on any Agent can be considered "virtual": the Agents' controller may remove 1 point of damage (1 token) from any Agent damaged by Maitreya for each 2 [RP]'s spent on that Agent. name: Manhole Surprise
text: Play this card to search your Bureau deck for a card with the BLUFF keyword. Reveal it to your opponent, then add it to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

text: Place this card next to a Site card as a Resource. name: Marty Glenn
text: Place three tokens on this card. Discard a token to add 2 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check. You may discard a token once per turn. Discard this resource when all tokens have been discarded.

name: Masked Identity
text: Play this card any time during a Combat on any Adversary. If the Adversary's HEALTH was not reduced to zero yet, you may allow that Adversary to end Combat and return the card to your hand, but you cannot play the Adversary again this turn.

name: Melissa Riedal-Ephessian
text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite to OCCULT INVESTIGATION 3+.

name: Messages From Beyond
text: Play this card to draw four cards, then place any two cards from your hand on top of your Bureau deck or in your discard pile.

name: Michelle Fazekas
text: Attach this Witness to any Agent in the Field. Adds 1 to that Agent's RES value during the Briefing Phase if that Agent is in the Field. Discard this card when the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to 0.

text: Play this card on any Agent to immediately skip one combat round for that Agent. The Agent takes no damage that round and may not deal any damage either.

name: Midnight Inquisitor
text: Discard this card to draw three cards from your Bureau deck during the requisition phase.

name: Mirage of Samantha
text: Choose one effect: Add 5 tokens to your [CP] pool or target player discards two cards at random from his hand.

Choose one of these Agents to use one of the other Agent's skills during a single skill check decreased by one (i.e. Scully could use Mulder's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill as 3). You can only have one of this card in your Bureau deck.

name: Mothman's Lair
text: The Mothman is negated if the Team it attacks makes a successful SUBTERFUGE +4 skill check. The LRC round is skipped. For the first round of CRC, the chosen Agent is the only one who may participate in the Combat. The Mothman may use SUBTERFUGE cards.

name: Never Again
text: Attach this card to any Agent in a Team investigating a Site to decrease all Agent's skills by one (LRC, CRC and HEALTH are not decreased). The final values cannot be negative. Discard this card when the Agent visits the Hospital.

name: No One So Paranoid

text: Adds 1 to the Agent's MEDICAL skill. Additionally, you can discard this card to add two to the Agent's SCIENCES skill.

name: Opening Fire

name: Otoscope
text: Adds 1 to the Agent's OBSERVATION skill. Additionally, you can discard this card to add two to the Agent's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill.

text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite to BEHAVIORAL 3+

text: If the Team successfully investigates this Site, the Investigation phase ends immediately. Any other Site cards in play without Bluff cards attached must be discarded.

name: Patti Rich
text: Adds 2 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL or adds 1 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: Persuasive Push
text: Play to prevent two Agents assigned to a Site from contributing their skills to one skill check (your choice) made by the Team this turn.

name: Pheromone Bio-Sensor

text: Zagraj te karte aby zobaczyc 3 karty z gory swojej talii Biura. Nastepnie mozesz umiescic je z powrotem w dowolnej kolejnosci.

text: Play on any combatant during one CRC round. That combatant will deal damage to their opponents first. If the HEALTH value of any opponent reaches zero after applying modifiers or healing cards, that combatant is sent to the Hospital and cannot deal any damage back that round.
