name: Santa Monica Peer, Los Angeles, CA
Satellite Navigator
text: Place 2 tokens on this card. Discard a token to look through your Bureau deck to draw any Site that asks a MOTIVE or METHOD question. Add it to your hand and reshuffle your Bureau deck. When no tokens remain, move this card to the Discard Pile.

name: Schlugg's Cult
text: Attach this card to any Agent in a Team. Place five tokens on this card (three if the Team has any Agent with MEDICAL skill). The Agent must remain in the Field and cannot contribute to any Skill check until all tokens have been removed. Remove one token during each Active player's Debriefing Phase. Discard this card when the last token is removed. The Agent remains in the Field. Schlugg's Cult does not initiate Combat.

name: Scripted Fate
text: Write down the question you think your opponent will ask if successfully investigates this Site. Place this card on your opponent's Field with the paper underneath. If your opponent asks that question, you are not forced to answer it. Otherwise, add 2 [CP] to your [CP] pool. Discard this card afterwards.

name: Scuba Suit
text: Once per turn, the Scuba Suit adds 2 to the Agent's OBSERVATION or SUBTERFUGE skills during any skill check on any Site card related to a coastal state or country, or mentioning the words: 'Lake', 'River' or 'Sea'.

name: Scully's Cancer
text: Play this card to force Agent Dana Scully's Team to make a BUREAUCRACY 4+ skill check. If they fail, move Scully to the Hospital immediately with zero HEALTH. Scully's recovery rate will be 1 damage token per turn. Attach this card to Scully as a reminder until she is fully healed.

name: Second Chance Memories
text: Play this card during the Investigation Phase. If a Team of Agents you control fails the Site prerequisite skill check, you may recover up to two cards played on that Site from your Discard Pile (your choice), including Combat cards, but you cannot play them again this turn.

name: First Move
text: Play this card during the Investigation phase (before any Combat has taken place) to search your Bureau deck for any one card with the keyword COMBAT. Reveal the card to your opponent, then add it to your hand. Shuffle your Bureau deck. If the card is playable this turn, you may play it at zero cost.

name: Sect Leader Anthony Tipet
text: You may play this card in its normal way, or use it to immediately end combat and control one Agent (your choice). Move the Agent to any section of the table. The Agent must remain in that section. Attach this card to the chosen Agent as a reminder. Discard this card during your opponent's next Investigation phase.

name: Section Chief Scott Blevins Assassinated
text: If your opponent uses Agent Blevins as RES 2, while being in the Bureau during the Briefing Phase, Agent Blevins is instantly killed and removed from the game.

name: Security Pass
text: Discard this card to change the Site Prerequisite to ALIEN INVESTIGATION or BUREAUCRACY in a Site investigated by the Agent equipped with this card. Keywords of the Site card are also changed

name: Serpent Siege
text: Play this card on any PRIMORDIAL Adversary. One of that Adversary's opponents (your choice) is paralyzed and will deal no damage during the next round of Combat.

name: Shadowed Dealings
text: The printed cost of any Bluff played at this Site is halved (rounded up).

name: Shared Secrets
text: Play this card any time after Diana Fowley's successfully investigates a Site with ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill in the same Team as Agent Fox Mulder. Place 3 additional tokens on Mulder's card. Remove this card from the game.

name: Sheriff Lucius Hartwell
text: Attach this Witness to any Agent in the Field. Adds 1 to that Agent's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill once per turn while the Agent is in the Field. Discard this card when the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to 0. If played on Agent Dana Scully this card costs 1 [RP] less.

name: Shitstorming the X-Files
text: Play this card to change the Site Prerequisite from CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION to SCIENCES.

name: Sister Abigail
text: Adds 1 [RP] to your pool every time a Keyword BEHAVIORAL or SUBTERFUGE card is played

name: Smoke Grenade
text: Play this card on any combatant during a LONG RANGE COMBAT round to reduce the damage from all opponent sources by one point.

name: Social Worker Contact
text: Discard this card during the Investigation phase to search through your Discard Pile and add one Keyword RESOURCE card to your hand. Show the card to your opponents.

name: Specimen Vessels
text: Adds 1 to the Agent's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill. Additionally, you can discard this card to add two to the Agent's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill.

name: Subliminal Assault
text: Play this card on a Team of two or more Agents. Choose an Agent at random and attach this card to that Agent. The Agent engages in Combat against the rest of Agents on the Team. You control the Agent as an Adversary until the Combat ends. Discard this card afterwards.

name: Suicide Run
text: Play this card on any Team of Agents at the end of any Combat round. If the Adversary you control is still alive, you may discard the Adversary to send to the Hospital any one Agent in the Team (your choice). That Agent is reduced to zero HEALTH.

name: Sussane Modeski
text: Attach this Witness to any Agent in the Field. Adds 1 to that Agent's BUREAUCRACY skill once per turn while the Agent is in the Field. Discard this card when the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to 0.

name: Tandem Investigations
text: Play this card when Agent Bill Patterson is about to use his Game Effect and only if Agent Nemhauser is in his same Team. Patterson's LRC and CRC skills are doubled during the Combat. Any opponents sent to the Hospital as a result of Patterson's LRC damage do not cause him any damage that round.

name: Telemedicine Tools
text: Place this Equipment card in your Hospital section. During your Healing phase, you may place one Keyword MEDICAL or SCIENCES ACTIVE card under this card, face down. During your Investigation phase, you may play one of these cards for 2 [RP] less. No more than 2 cards may be under this card.

name: Tempus Fugit
text: Play this card during the Briefing Phase to force any opponent to skip the next Healing, Requisition and Deployment phases and go directly to the Case Assignment phase. Remove this card from the game. The effects of this card may not be negated.

name: The African Artifact
text: Attach this card to an Agent with cost higher than three. Once you had successfully investigated a Site, you may remove this card and the Agent from play to ask an extra characteristic question regarding one opponent's X-File.

name: The Bat Thing
text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped. This card may be played in its normal way or on any Team that includes at least one Agent with the keyword SKEPTIC, ignoring Activator requirements. The Bat Thing may use SUBTERFUGE Combat cards.

name: The Devil's Choice
text: Discard the top card from both players' Bureau decks. If your card has higher cost than your opponent's, you may add 8 tokens to your [RP] pool (if you are the active player) or to the [CP] pool (if you are the Directed player). If lower, only empty your [RP] and [CP] pools, your opponent's pools remain unaffected. Then, shuffle both Bureau Decks.

name: The Elder's Call
text: Put two tokens on this card. You can use a token to keep at your side a non-resource Witness card or a Site for an additional turn. Remove a token each time you use this ability. You can use both in the same turn. Remove this card from the game once all the tokens have been removed.

name: The End
text: Play this card after answering "no" to a Characteristic Question regarding your X-File. Your opponent cannot ask about the same Characteristic for the next X turns, up to a maximum of three. X = [CP] cost paid.

name: The Falls at Arcadia, San Diego County, CA
The Great Mutato
text: Play this card during the Case Assignment phase and place it in the Field. Discard this card to negate one ADVERSARY card played by your opponent this turn (or discard it in any case at the end of the Investigation Phase).

name: The Grey-Haired Man
text: Reduce each Agent's LRC to 1. If target Team has more than one Agent, Your opponent may select one of those Agents not to participate in the Combat. If no Agent is chosen, then an additional LRC round will be played until your opponent selects an Agent to skip the Combat.

name: The Lone Gunman
text: Play this card to search through your Bureau Deck and draw one Keyword ACTIVE card that increases an Agent or Team skill check during the Investigation phase. Add the card to your hand and reveal it to your opponent. Shuffle your deck.

name: The Overcoat Woman
text: Force your opponent to reveal their hand. Select one [CP] card. You may either play the selected card immediately (at its normal cost) or send it directly to its owner's Discard Pile. If played, the card is discarded afterwards.

name: The Right Hand's Toll
text: Pay 2 [CP] to move up to 3 [RP] from your opponent's [RP] pool to your [CP] pool immediately.

name: The Siddhi Mystic's Curse
text: Draw a number of cards from your Bureau deck equal to the number of Agents on target team. Use the cost value of each drawn card to assign damage to any Agent in that team (your choice) as separated LRC attacks. Draw enough cards until you have numerical values to assign the damage. Shuffle the deck (including the drawn cards.

name: The Toothpick Man
text: Play this card to negate one Witness card played by your opponent. Each player may only have one of this card in their deck. Remove this card from the game.

name: The Truth
text: Play this card after having successfully investigated a Site to ask an X-File's identity without incurring a penalty question. Remove this card from the game.

name: The Twins Poisonous Attack
text: This card does not initiate combat. The Team must make an OBSERVATION 5+ skill check. If unsuccessful, choose one Agent in the Team. That Agent receives 4 points of damage but can still contribute with his skills if HEALTH rating has not been reduced to 0. Healing cards can be played to avoid the damage, as usual.

name: The Walk
text: Subtract one from all damage sources applied to this Adversary.

name: They are Watching
text: Play this card to force your opponent to play with an open hand (all cards face up) until end of turn. If a card forces your opponent to discard any card randomly from their hand, you may choose them directly.

name: Third Elder's Deliberation
text: During the Briefing Phase, remove one Game Effect token on any Agent that normally starts with at least one token. You may only have one of this card in your Bureau deck. Remove this card from play.

name: Three of a Kind
text: You may use this card to place up to six cards under it (face down) at any time. These cards cannot contain the Activator CONSPIRACY. You can play cards from here as if they were in your hand, with their cost increased by 1. Discard all cards if this card is negated. Each player may only have one of this card in their deck.

name: Three Words, One Solution
text: Play this card to discard all [CP] tokens from your opponent's pool. The first card with [CP] cost played by your opponent may be played for free this turn.

name: Time Rush
text: Place this card in the Field. At the beginning of each player's Debriefing Phase, each player must draw one card from their Bureau Deck and then discard one card from their Bureau Deck. Afterwards, both players must reduce their hand to seven cards, as usual.

name: Too Close To The Truth
text: Play this card to allow you to exchange [CP] Pools with your opponent.

name: Tossing Maneuver
text: Negates the effects of any one Equipment card that adds to CLOSE RANGE COMBAT Skill for the duration of this combat.

name: Tracking the Trail
text: Put this card in your Bureau section. Add 1 [RP] to your [RP] pool for every Event card you play as Active player.

name: Tricky Trick
text: Play this card immediately after you have received a "yes" answer to the X-File Characteristic. You may take one [RP] card from your Discard Pile and add it to your hand.

name: Trust Conflict
text: Discard X cards from your hand to draw X cards from the top of your Bureau deck.

name: Trust_no1@mail.com
text: Select one card with the Keyword CONSPIRACY from your Discard Pile and reveal it to your opponent. Place it in your hand. You cannot use the card this turn.

name: Truthful Journey
text: You may move up to two Agents from the Bureau Section to the Field immediately. This card may not be played once an Adversary has forced combat until after the combat is resolved. If two Agents are moved, they must join the same Team in the Field.

name: Ultimate Deception
text: Force an opposing Agent (your choice) to go to the Hospital immediately and may not contribute to the Site skill check. The Agent takes two points of damage and must be fully healed to leave the Hospital.

name: Unclassified Reports
text: Attach this card to any Agent and put three cards from your Discard Pile under it. Any time during the game, you may discard one of the cards to gain a +1 modifier on one of the Keywords listed on that card. Discard this card when no cards remain under it.

name: Undercovered Broadcast
text: Put this card in your Bureau section. Add 1 [CP] to your [CP] pool for every Event card you play as Directed player.

name: Unearthly Exposure
text: Place this card on any Agent in the Field investigating a Site with two tokens on it. The Agent is removed from play. Remove one token during each of the controlling player's Healing Phases. When no tokens remain, move the Agent to the Field.

name: Unearthly Harvest
text: Play this card to exchange both pools ([RP] and [CP]) with your opponent.

name: Unexpected Hospital Visit
text: Attach this card to any Agent with cost of 5 [RP] or less who is investigating this Site. Each time this Agent investigates any Site, you may pay that cost to force that Agent to go to the Hospital (undamaged). This card is removed when a Healing card is played on the Agent.

name: Unexpected Stroke
text: Discard two cards from your hand (your choice) to apply a -2 modifier to any Agent's skill check on this Site.

name: Unnatural Illusion
text: Negate any one Keyword ALIEN, ALIEN MANIPULATION or ALIEN INVESTIGATION card.

name: Unstoppable Ally
text: Play this card during a Close Range Combat round to search your Bureau Deck for any one card with the keyword COMBAT. Reveal the card to your opponent and add it to your hand. Shuffle your Bureau deck. If the card is immediately playable, You may do so for zero cost.

name: Unstoppable Pursuit
text: Play this card during the Case Assignment phase to move one Agent in a Team assigned to a Site to another Team in the Field assigned to a different Site.

name: Van Allen's Revenge
text: Once the Combat ends, you may pay 2 [CP] to return Van Allen's Revenge to your hand. It may be played again at the same Site. Your opponent may pay 3 [RP] to cancel this effect.

name: Vassily Peskow
text: The chosen Agent is the only one who may participate in the Combat. This card cannot be played over Agent Alex Krycek. Vassily Peskow can use SUBTERFUGE cards.

name: Vicki Burdick
text: Adds 3 to one Team's OBSERVATION or adds 2 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL skill check.

name: Virtual Training
text: This card adds 2 points to an Agent's LRC or CRC skill (your choice) during the Combat.

name: Visions of a Shaman
text: Pick the top three cards of your Bureau deck. Use the cost of the first one for the Shaman's LRC skill, the cost of the second as CRC, and the last one as HEALTH value (draw additional cards if needed if the cost of any of those cards is not a specific number). Shuffle your Bureau afterwards (including the drawn cards).

name: Visions of Homicide
text: Play this card to allow you to look the top five cards of your opponent's Bureau deck. You can perform this action at the beginning of your opponent's Briefing Phase.

name: Voodoo Ritual
text: Play this card to decrease the cost of the first Adversary card you play in this Site by two.

name: Voodoo Unleashed
text: Play on one Team in the Field. If the Team makes an OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check 5+, then they may add 2 to any Site skill check. Discard this card after you have used the Modifier.

name: We Are Not Alone
text: The next cards that you play on this site will have their cost increased by 1. Your opponents may not negate any of those cards this turn.

name: Weakening Grip
text: Discard a card at random from your opponent's hand for each Agent investigating this Site.

name: Wetwired
text: Play on an Agent in a Team of 2 or more Agents. That Agent initiates Combat against another Agent in the Team (your choice). Follow usual Combat rules until any of the Agents' HEALTH is reduced to zero. The Combat ends and that Agent (or both) must go to the Hospital. The remaining Team may still contribute to the Site skill check as usual.

name: Whanshang Dole
text: Wanshang Dhole deals damage to its opponents first during each CRC round. If the HEALTH value of any opponent reaches zero after applying modifiers or healing cards,that combatant is sent to the Hospital and cannot deliver any damage back that round.

name: Whispers of Hearts
text: Play on one Agent to allow that Agent to use their EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill number for any one BEHAVIORAL or CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check.

name: William
text: Apply a +2 modifier to any one skill check made by a Team of Agents in the Field during the Investigation phase.

name: Witch Hunter
text: Search your Bureau deck and choose any one keyword OCCULT or OCCULT INVESTIGATION card. Show this card to your opponent, add it to your hand and shuffle your Bureau Deck.

name: X
text: Negate any one Keyword ADVERSARY card.

name: X's Final Struggle
text: Place this card on your opponent's side. While this card is in play, your opponent cannot use cards nor Agent's Game Effects that allow them to draw cards (or search for cards) from the Bureau deck or from the Discard Pile. During your Briefing Phase pay 1 [CP] or discard this card.

name: Zelma's Palm Readings, North Minneapolis, MN
Éí 'Aaníígóó 'Áhoot'é
text: Play to change a Site Prerequisite to ALIEN INVESTIGATION 3+.

name: Cape Flattery Trail, Neah Bay, WA
Choléra the Cat
text: Adds 1 to the Agent's CLOSE RANGE COMBAT skill. Place a token on this card. Remove a token to search through your Bureau Deck and add any one Keyword HEALING card to your hand. Shuffle your deck.

name: Confronting the Shape
text: Play this card when an Adversary is about to enter Combat with a single Agent. Search through your Bureau Deck and add any one Combat card to your hand. Reshuffle your Bureau Deck.

name: Don't Turn Around!
text: Play this card to apply a -2 modifier to the Site skill check. In addition, one Agent on the Team (your choice) may not contribute their Combat skills this turn.

name: FN Herstal Five-seveN
text: Adds 3 to the Agent's CLOSE RANGE COMBAT skill.

name: Funicular
text: Attach this card to an Agent in the Field. Discard this card to search through your Bureau Deck and add any one Keyword MOVE card to your hand. Show the card to your opponent and shuffle your Bureau Deck. If the card is immediately playable, you may do so for zero [RP] cost.

name: Grey Wind - Coastal Northwest Werewolf
text: This card may be played at a Site where another Coastal Northwest Werewolf has been played, ignoring Activator requirements. The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped.

name: Johnathon Woods
text: Attach this card to an OCCULT INVESTIGATION Site during your Case Assignment Phase together with two tokens. The Site stays in the Field as long as this card is attached. Remove a token every time you send a Team of Agents to investigate the Site. Discard this card when the last token is removed.

name: Katina Arvidson
text: Adds 2 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL or adds 1 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check. The Witness's modifier is doubled if played on a Team that includes Delaney Arvidson.

name: Knuffle Bunny
text: Adds 2 to the Agent's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill. OCCULT Adversaries must assign damage to this Agent. This card is free if the attached Agent has the Keyword CUTE.

name: Lauren Evans Osborne
text: Place three tokens on this card. Discard a token to add 2 to one Team's OBSERVATION skill check. You may discard a token once per turn. Discard this resource when all tokens have been discarded.

name: Living Scarecrow
text: The cost to play this card is 3 [CP] if the Site Prerequisite is OCCULT INVESTIGATION. LRC and CRC attacks cause only half damage (rounded up) to this Adversary.

name: Lurking in Plain Sight
text: Force an opponent Team to make an OBSERVATION 4+ skill check. If they fail, apply a -3 modifier to the Site skill check and your opponent must discard all Witness cards from their hand.

name: Maggi Forrester
text: Play this card to reduce the Site Prerequisite of any one COMPUTER or OCCULT INVESTIGATION Site by 1. This card is free is played at "Forks High School".

name: Martin Shultz
text: Adds 2 to one Team's OBSERVATION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check. This card is free if played on a Team that includes Yumi Sagiuchi Shultz.

name: Maya - Coastal Northwest Vampire
text: LONG RANGE COMBAT will cause no damage to the Vampire. This Adversary gains +1 CLOSE RANGE COMBAT for each subsequent round of CRC that her HEALTH is no at zero.

name: Michael Myers
text: This Adversary regenerates (Heals) two points of HEALTH at the beginning of each combat round as long as his HEALTH is not at 0. Michael Myers may use SUBTERFUGE cards. If killed in combat, return Myers to your Bureau deck and shuffle.

name: More Men in Black
text: Force an opponent Team to make a SUBTERFUGE 4+ skill check. If unsuccessful, the Site Prerequisite is increased by 1 for each Agent on the Team that does not have a SUBTERFUGE skill value.

name: Peter Shultz
text: Adds 2 to one Team's COMPUTER or adds 1 to one Team's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check.

name: Psychokinetic Attack
text: Play this card on any Agent with OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill of 1+ to make one LONG RANGE COMBAT attack at LRC skill: 7. The opposing side's LRC attack is negated if the damaged combatant's Health is reduced to 0.

name: Reproduction Movie Props
text: Adds 2 to the Agent's COMPUTER and SUBTERFUGE skills.

name: Sahale - Coastal Northwest Werewolf
text: This card may be played at a Site where another Coastal Northwest Werewolf has been played, ignoring Activator requirements. The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped.

name: Seamus the Cat
text: Play this card to gently push two cards off the top of your opponent's Bureau deck. The two cards are discarded.

name: Shadow - Coastal Northwest Werewolf
text: This card may be played at a Site where another Coastal Northwest Werewolf has been played, ignoring Activator requirements. The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped.

name: Silver Bullets
text: Adds 3 to an Agent's LONG RANGE COMBAT and CLOSE RANGE COMBAT skills when played against an OCCULT Adversary for the duration of this combat.

name: Slender Man
text: Play this card on a Team in the Field that plays a Witness. The Witness is discarded and the Team is attacked! Agents must immediately discard all attached "Camera" Equipment cards. Slender Man is unaffected by MARTIAL ARTS cards. Damage caused by this Adversary may be split among all opponents (Directed Player's choice).

name: Tahoma - Coastal Northwest Werewolf
text: This card may be played at a Site where another Coastal Northwest Werewolf has been played, ignoring Activator requirements. The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped.

name: Troll Territory
text: Play this card to reduce the [CP] Cost of all Keyword SUBTERFUGE cards played at this Site by 1. While this card is in play, any OCCULT or EVOLUTIONARY Adversaries played at this Site may use SUBTERFUGE Combat cards.

name: Unearthing the Monster
text: Play on a Team in the Field. If the Team makes an OBSERVATION 4+ skill check then you may search through your Bureau Deck and add any keyword CREATURE Adversary to your hand. Show the card to your opponent and shuffle your deck.

name: A Scully Family Gathering
text: Play this card on a Team with Dana Scully to search through your Bureau Deck and add one of the following cards to your hand: "Margaret Scully", "Queequeg", "Melissa Scully", "Tara Scully", or "Father McCue". If you play the chosen card immediately, then you may do so for half cost (rounded up).

name: A Well-Placed Patsy
text: Play this card when your opponent either uses a token or plays a card to negate your GOVERNMENT Adversary or Event. Discard one Witness card from your hand to negate the effect.

name: Advice From a Loser
text: Negate one EVOLUTIONARY Adversary. In addition, if the Team makes a CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check 6+, they may ask either one MOTIVE or one METHOD question.

name: Aggressive Recall Therapy
text: Attach this card to one of your Agents to apply a -1 modifier to the Agent's HEALTH. While this Agent is in the Field, your opponent must randomly reveal one card in their hand, once per turn. When this Resource is discarded, the Agent's HEALTH is restored.

name: Airlift
text: Play on a Team during the Deployment Phase. If the Team makes an ALIEN INVESTIGATION 5+ skill check, they may investigate two Sites in either the same state or neighboring states this turn.

name: Alien Bounty Healer
text: Play on an Agent in the Hospital. The Agent heals up to three tokens of damage and any afflicting Keywords (i.e. CANCER, INSANITY) are removed.

name: Alien Death Grip
text: Play on any Adversary to add 1 to its CLOSE RANGE COMBAT skill check. In addition, if the Adversary is ALIEN, play on the chosen Agent in Combat to negate their combat skills this round.

name: Angie Pintero
text: Adds 1 to one Team's BUREAUCRACY or OBSERVATION skill check.

name: Apollo 11 Keychain
text: Adds 1 to the Agent's RES value. This card may be attached at zero cost if played after one of your Agents has been removed from the game. Each player may only have one of this card in their decks.

name: Ariel Weiss
text: Adds 1 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check once per turn. Alternately, you may discard this card to negate the Adversary "The Golem Exacts Revenge".

name: Ariel's Wedding Ring
text: Attach this card to a Witness RESOURCE. While in play, this card enables your Agents to attack OCCULT CREATURES otherwise unaffected by Combat attacks. This card remains in play until the attached Witness is discarded or removed from the game.

name: Aura Photography
text: If the Team makes a SCIENCES 4+ skill check, add five tokens to the [RP] Pool.

name: Biohazard Suit
text: Agents equipped with a Biohazard Suit have access to the Field Office Crime Lab. Adds 2 to the Agent's SCIENCES skill.

name: Bitter Defeat
text: Place in your Field section with two tokens on this card. Remove a token to double the [CP] cost of any one Bluff played by your opponent. If your opponent is unable to pay the augmented cost, the Bluff is discarded. Discard this resource after both tokens are removed.

name: Blindside
text: Play on any PRIMORDIAL Adversary to allow it to deal all of its damage in the round before its opponents. Any opponents sent to the Hospital as a result of this damage do not cause damage this round.

name: Booby Trap
text: Play on a Team of two or more Agents investigating a Keyword MONO Site to increase the Site Prerequisite to 5+. If the Team makes a BEHAVIORAL 4+ skill check, this card is negated. If they fail to make the Site skill check, one Agent (your choice) takes 3 points of damage and the increased Site Prerequisite remains in effect.

name: Cancer Diagnosis
text: Play this card to add CANCER to an opposing Agent's Keywords. The Agent's HEALTH is reduced by 1 for each of your opponent's Debriefing Phases that the Agent doesn't spend in the Hospital. If the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to zero, they must remain in the Hospital until HEALTH is restored. This card is removed when a Healing card is played on the Agent.

name: Cancerous Nosebleed
text: Play this card to add CANCER to an opposing Agent's Keywords. The Agent's HEALTH is reduced by one for each of the opponent's Debriefing Phases that the Agent spends outside of the Hospital. If the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to zero, they must remain in the Hospital until HEALTH is restored. This card is removed when a Healing card is played on the Agent.

name: Carver's Accommodation
text: Play on a Team in which one Agent has just been abducted or removed from the game. Search your Bureau Deck and draw one Keyword LAW Agent card and use it immediately at no cost. Reshuffle your Deck. Discard the Agent at the end of your turn.

name: Chemotherapy
text: Play this card on an Agent in the Hospital. The Agent heals one token of damage immediately. This card heals up to two tokens of damage if the Agent has the Keyword CANCER.

name: Chimera Man
text: Adds 1 to the Agent's ALIEN INVESTIGATION and EVIDENCE COLLECTION skills. While this card is in play any Keyword GOVERNMENT Adversary may ignore Activator requirements when attacking the Agent's Team.

name: Chuck's Resources
text: Play this card any time after Dr. Charles Burks' game effect token has been removed. Place a new token on Burks' card. Remove this card from the game.

name: Close-Quarters Battle
text: Play on any PRIMORDIAL or EVOLUTIONARY Adversary during a round of CLOSE RANGE COMBAT. The round will be fought between the Adversary and one Agent of your choice. No other combatants may participate in this CRC round. This card is free if the target Agent has the Keyword CANCER.

name: Cloth Hearts
text: Place 2 tokens on this card. Remove a token to take any one Witness from your Discard Pile that modifies a skill check and use it immediately for zero cost. Discard this card when both tokens have been removed.

name: Composite Sketch
text: Adds 1 to the Agent's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION and EVIDENCE COLLECTION skills.

name: Conrad Lozano
text: Adds 2 to one Team's SUBTERFUGE or 1 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check. If your opponent plays a PHENOMENA CREATURE Adversary while this card is in play, Lozano is negated and removed from the game.

name: Coroner Glenna
text: Place three tokens on this card. Discard a token to add 2 to one Team's MEDICAL skill check. You may discard a token once per turn. Discard this Resource when all tokens have been removed.

name: Cover Credentials
text: Prior to the Requisition Phase, play this card on a Team of two Agents. This Team may use the [CP] Pool to pay for Equipment and a Site in their respective phases. In addition, your opponent cannot play Bluffs on this Site nor attack the Team with GOVERNMENT Adversaries. Discard this card at the end of your turn.

name: Crisis Counseling
text: Play this card on an Agent when they are in the Bureau with Agent Karen Kosseff. At the start of your next turn, you may discard this resource to either heal one token of damage or remove any one afflicted Keyword (i.e. CANCER, INSANITY) from the Agent.

name: Darlene Morris
text: Place three tokens on this card. Discard a token to add 2 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check. You may discard a token once per turn. Discard this Resource when all tokens have been removed.

name: Defibrillator
text: Attach this card to any Agent with a MEDICAL skill of 1+ and place two tokens on the card. Remove a token to either heal one point of damage or to negate any one EVOLUTIONARY Adversary. Discard the Defibrillator when all tokens have been removed.

name: Denny Markham
text: Attach this Witness to any one Keyword INDEPENDENT Agent. Adds 1 to the Agent's SUBTERFUGE skill once per turn. Discard this card when the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to zero.

name: Denny Murphy, Geologist
text: Adds 2 to one Team's SCIENCES or adds 1 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check. If your opponent plays an ALIEN Adversary while this card is in play, Murphy is negated and removed from the game.

name: Deputy Dennis Tyson
text: Adds 1 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check, or play this card to negate "Sheriff Daniels".

name: Desk Jockey
text: Play on an opposing Agent in the Bureau. The Agent may not leave the Bureau or add their skills to a skill check until a Team has successfully investigated a Site with Keywords CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or OCCULT INVESTIGATION.

name: Detective Joe Curtis
text: Force your opponent to discard one Witness from their hand. If your opponent has no Witnesses in their hand, this card has no effect. If your opponent has a Witness to discard, attach Detective Curtis to one Investigating Agent (your choice). The Agent is arrested and removed from play until the remaining Agents make a CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION 4+ skill check.

name: Dr. Arlinsky
text: Adds 1 to one Team's SCIENCES skill check once per turn. If your opponent plays a GOVERNMENT Adversary while this card is in play, Arlinsky is negated and removed from the game.

name: Dr. Jack Franklin
text: If this Adversary is played on a Witness that contributes to a MEDICAL skill check, the Witness is removed from the game. The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped for the opposing Team but not for Dr. Jack Franklin. Agents must use their MEDICAL skill as their value in CLOSE RANGE COMBAT. If an Agent has no MEDICAL skill, their value is 1.

name: Dr. Larry Steen
text: Adds 3 to one Team's SCIENCES or adds 2 to one Team's COMPUTER skill check, or play this card to heal any one Agent damaged by the effects of "El Chupacabra".

name: Dr. Lisa Ianelli
text: Adds 1 to one Team's COMPUTER skill check once per turn.

name: Dr. Shannon
text: Adds 2 to one Team's MEDICAL or adds 1 to one Team's COMPUTER skill check.

name: Dr. Vitagliano
text: Place three tokens on this card. Discard a token to add 2 to one Team's SCIENCES skill check. You may discard a token once per turn. Discard this Resource when all tokens have been Resource.

name: Early Parole
text: Play on an Agent in the section of the table designated The Gulag to immediately remove one token of imprisonment.

name: Ed Jerse and His Talking Tattoo
text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped. Any Agent wounded by this Adversary is afflicted with the Keyword INSANITY. This effect remains in place until all damage tokens are removed.

name: El Chupacabra
text: Place five tokens on any Agent damaged by El Chupacabra's attack. Discard a token in each of the afflicted Agent's Briefing Phases. When the last token is removed, the Agent is removed from the game. This effect can only be negated by the remaining Team making a SCIENCES 3+ skill check or by playing a HEALING card prior to the Agent being removed.

name: Elaine Tanner
text: Play this card to increase the applicable HEALTH of any Keyword EVOLUTIONARY or PRIMORDIAL Adversaries played at this Site by 2.

name: Encore
text: Play this card immediately after discarding an OCCULT Adversary as a result of either Combat or a Negate effect. The Adversary is returned to the Field at no cost and may attack the Team again.

name: Epoxy Vat
text: Agents equipped with an Epoxy Vat have access to the Field Office Crime Lab. Adds 1 to the Agent's MEDICAL and SCIENCES skills.

name: Everything Dies
text: Play this card to prevent any Adversaries that initiate combat from being negated at this Site. Combat must take place and is resolved normally.

name: Exhumation
text: Select one Adversary card from your Discard Pile and add it to your hand.

name: Extended Sentence
text: Play on an Agent in the section of the table designated The Gulag. Place an additional token of imprisonment on the Agent. The Agent must remain in The Gulag until all tokens are removed.

name: Father McCue
text: Play on any one Agent in the Field or Hospital. An Agent with the Keyword BELIEVER immediately heals two tokens of damage. All other Agents immediately heal one token of damage. If played on either Scully or Mulder, treat Scully as a Keyword BELIEVER and treat Mulder as a Keyword SKEPTIC.

name: Flight 549 Crash Site, Upstate New York
Forensic Excavation
text: Take any two Keyword EVIDENCE or WITNESS cards from your discard pile. Add one card to your hand and play the other card immediately at no cost.

name: Gerry Schnauz Senses Your Unrest
text: This card does not initiate Combat. Select one opposing Agent for abduction. Place this card on top of the Agent along with five tokens. Remove a token in each of the Agent's Briefing Phases. When the last token is discarded, the Agent is removed from the game. This effect can only be negated by the remaining Agents making an EVIDENCE COLLECTION 4+ skill check prior to the Agent being removed.

name: Gerry Schnauz's RV, Traverse City, MI
Ghostly Visitations
text: Attach this card to one of your Agents. While this card is in play, your opponent must play with all Keyword OCCULT cards in their hand face-up on the table. This card is free if played on an Agent with the Keyword CANCER. Discard this card if your Agent's HEALTH is reduced to zero.

name: Goldstein's Complicity
text: Play this card to change the Site Prerequisite from MEDICAL to CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION. If your opponent fails this Site skill check, add 5 [CP] to your pool.

name: Grainy Footage
text: Once this card is played, the opposing Team may not use or apply skill values from any Keyword ELECTRICAL Equipment while investigating this Site.

name: Gulag Commandant
text: Play in conjunction with any GOVERNMENT Adversary. If an Agent's HEALTH is reduced to zero, place the Agent in a section of the table designated The Gulag and discard any Equipment. The Agent remains imprisoned for three full turns or until a Keyword ESCAPE card is played on them. Place three tokens on the Agent and remove one during each of the Agent's Briefing Phases. When the last token is removed, move the Agent to the Bureau (undamaged).

name: Gulag-Bird
text: Place this card beneath an Agent to move them to a section of the table designated The Gulag. Place three tokens on the Agent (two tokens if played on Alex Krycek). Remove one token during each of your opponent's Debriefing Phases. While in play, the Agent may not move or contribute to any skill checks. All Equipment attached to the imprisoned Agent is discarded immediately. Discard this card when the last token is removed and move the Agent to the Bureau.

name: Happy Birthday
text: Play on one Agent during the Briefing Phase to double the Agent's RES for one turn. In addition, you may requisition one Equipment card to the Agent at no cost. Each player may only have one of this card in their decks.

name: Harold Spuller
text: Place three tokens on this card. Remove a token and pick a number between 0 and 12. Your opponent must show you all cards in their hand that cost the same as the chosen number. Discard this card when all tokens have been removed.

name: Hospital Gown
text: Attach this card to an Agent in the Hospital and place two tokens on it. Discard a token to either heal one point of damage or to remove a game effect token from the Agent. Discard the Hospital Gown when all tokens have been removed.

name: In the Crosshairs
text: Flip a coin in the air. If the coin lands on heads, your opponent must discard the following cards from their hand: "No One So Paranoid", "The Lone Gunmen", "Langly", "Frohike", "Byers", and "Call On Us More Often". The listed cards may not be used to negate this card.

name: Insanity on Rye
text: Place this card on an opposing Agent in the Field to change one Keyword LAW or INDEPENDENT to INSANITY. This card is removed when a Healing card is played on the afflicted Agent.

name: Inspector Puett
text: Adds 1 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill check, or play this card to force your opponent to randomly shuffle one card from their hand back into their Bureau Deck.

name: Jailbreak
text: Play on an Agent in the section of the table designated The Gulag. The imprisoned Agent is immediately moved to the Bureau (undamaged).

name: Jason Ludwig
text: Play to change a Site Prerequisite to BEHAVIORAL 3+.

name: Keep Your Distance
text: Unless this card is negated, your opponent may not negate any cards that would send an Agent to The Gulag section of the table (or cards affecting Agents in The Gulag) while this Site is being investigated.

name: Kenneth Ungar
text: Place three tokens on this card. Discard a token to add 2 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check. You may discard a token once per turn. Discard this Resource when all tokens have been removed.

name: Kurt Crawford
text: Play this card to remove the Keyword CANCER from an afflicted Agent. You may have up to five Kurt Crawford cards in your deck.

name: Legal Representation
text: Play this card to increase the cost of all Witnesses played at this Site by 2 [RP].

name: Leonard Betts
text: This card is free if played on a Keyword CANCER card and Activator requirements are ignored. Leonard Betts regenerates 1 point of HEALTH for each Witness discarded from your hand.

name: Lt. Terry Wilmer
text: Adds 1 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION skill check once during your turn. While in play, you may Discard this Resource during your opponent's turn to play the "Alien Bounty Hunter" at no cost, Activator requirements permitting.

name: Maintain Deniability
text: For the remainder of this turn, your opponent may only play Keyword GOVERNMENT cards.

name: Make History
text: Negate any one Keyword ALIEN or Keyword ALIEN INVESTIGATION card.

name: Marcus Duff, INS
text: Adds 2 to onr Team's BUREAUCRACY or adds 1 to one Team's COMPUTER skill check, or play this card to return "Samuel Aboah" to the bottom of the owning player's Bureau Deck.

name: Martin Alpert
text: Adds 2 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL or BUREAUCRACY skill check. While this card is in play, the Witness card "Harold Spuller" may be played for free.

name: Michel the Clubgoer
text: Adds 1 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or OBSERVATION skill check. Alternately, play this card when one of your Agents is the target of "Brother Martin is Attracted to You". Discard Michel to negate the Adversary.

name: Michelle Wilkes
text: Adds 1 to one Team's MEDICAL skill check once per turn. If your opponent plays an EVOLUTIONARY Adversary while this card is in play, Michelle Wilkes is negated and removed from the game.

name: Mid-Air Abduction
text: Play to force the Investigating player to discard all Keyword ALIEN INVESTIGATION and OBSERVATION cards in their hand. In addition, any and all Witnesses played at this Site are immediately afflicted with the Keyword ABDUCTEE (due to residual radiation) even after this card is resolved.

name: Migrant Workers Camp, San Joaquin, CA
Minister Diabria
text: Adds 1 [RP] to your Pool every time a Keyword BUREAUCRACY or SUBTERFUGE card is played.

name: Misty Nagata
text: Attach this card to Assistant Director Skinner. Adds 1 to Skinner's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill once per turn. Discard this card when Skinner's HEALTH is reduced to zero.

name: Moral Quagmire
text: Attach this card to either an Agent in the Bureau section or one that is investigating a Site. The Agent is afflicted with the Keyword TRAITOR and may only contribute to SUBTERFUGE and Combat skill checks until this card is removed. Discard this card when an Agent is part of a Team that successfully investigates a Site. This card is free if played on a Keyword NEUTRAL Agent.

name: Mortality Imminent
text: Place this card on an opposing Agent afflicted with the Keyword CANCER. The Agent is immediately moved to the Hospital (if not already there) and must remain in the Hospital until the Keyword CANCER is removed.

name: Mrs. Peacock
text: Force your opponent to discard one Witness RESOURCE in play. In addition, PRIMORDIAL Adversaries may ignore Activator requirements to attack Agents at this Site.

name: Nathaniel Teager
text: Only Agents with OBSERVATION as a skill may apply their LRC and CRC skills in Combat. This Adversary may use SUBTERFUGE cards at no cost.

name: Needle Neck
text: Play on any ALIEN or GOVERNMENT Adversary to negate all damage allocated to that Adversary this round. This card may be played to negate the effects of "Alien Stiletto."

name: Next Patient
text: Discard one Witness card from your hand to apply a -2 modifier to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION or MEDICAL skill check.

name: No Trespassing
text: Play this card to prevent all Agents with the Keyword FBI from contributing to any skill checks occurring at this Site.

name: Nobody Cares
text: Any Adversaries played at this Site are shuffled back into your Bureau Deck instead of the Discard Pile.

name: Nurse Innes
text: Play this card on a Team in the Field that plays a Witness. Discard the Witness and skip the LONG RANGE COMBAT round. For the first round of CLOSE RANGE COMBAT, the chosen Agent is the only one who may participate in the Combat.

name: Nurse Rebecca Waite
text: Adds 3 to one Team's MEDICAL or adds 2 to one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check. If your opponent plays an OCCULT Adversary while this card is in play, Nurse Waite is negated and removed from the game.

name: Officer Corning
text: Adds 1 to your [RP] Pool every time a Keyword CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or PRIMORDIAL card is played.

name: Officer Down!
text: Negates the effects of any one Witness that modifies a LONG RANGE COMBAT or CLOSE RANGE COMBAT skill check. The Witness is discarded prior to dealing damage in the Combat round. This card is free if played on an Adversary that is capable of using SUBTERFUGE Combat cards.

name: Old Man Nichols
text: If this Adversary is played on a Keyword SCIENCES Witness, the Witness is negated and removed from the game. The Long Range Combat round is skipped. Any Agent wounded by Nichols is instantly frozen and may not move, contribute their skills and effects, add to the Pools, or heal wounds until a HEALING card is played on the Agent.

name: Postmortem
text: If the Team makes a MEDICAL 4+ skill check, add five tokens to the [RP] Pool.

name: Quarantine Zone
text: Place this card on top of an opponent's Site and place two tokens on it. Remove a token during each of their following Briefing Phases. While this card is in play, the Site cannot be resolved. The Team may not move or contribute their skills until the last token is removed, except for Agents equipped with a "Biohazard Suit".

name: Ratboy's Prosthesis
text: Attach this card to an Agent with the Keyword NEUTRAL or a SUBTERFUGE skill of 1+. As long as the Agent in the Field, their SUBTERFUGE skill value is increased by 1 for each point of damage affecting them.

name: Reconnaissance
text: Play this card during the Investigation Phase. Make an OBSERVATION 4+ skill check to search through your Bureau Deck and draw one Keyword WEAPON or ARMOR Equipment card. Attach the Equipment to an Agent at half-cost (rounded up), ignoring Activator requirements.

name: Regeneration
text: Play immediately after discarding an EVOLUTIONARY Adversary as a result of either Combat or a Negate effect. The Adverary is returned to the Field at no cost and may attack the Team again.

name: Roche Takes a Hostage
text: Force an opponent Team to make a SUBTERFUGE 4+ skill check. If they fail, apply a -2 modifier to the Site skill check and negate all prior Witnesses that are modifying the Team's skill check.

name: Russian Horsemen
text: If an Agent's HEALTH is reduced to zero by this Adversary, place the Agent in a section of the table designated The Gulag and discard any Equipment. The Agent remains imprisoned for three full turns or until a Keyword ESCAPE card is played on them. Place three tokens on the Agent and remove one during each of the Agent's Briefing Phases. When the last token is removed, move the Agent to the Bureau (undamaged).

name: S.W.A.T. Tactical Gear
text: Adds 1 to the Agent's LRC and CRC skills. Additionally, place 3 tokens on this card. Remove a token to prevent one point of damage. Discard the Tactical Gear when all tokens have been removed. Excess damage is applied to the Agent as normal. This card cannot be sold for [CP].

name: Saint Elias Mountains, Yukon Territory, Canada
Samantha, Agrarian Clone
text: Adds 1 [RP] to your Pool each time a Keyword ALIEN or ALIEN INVESTIGATION card is played.

name: Samuel Aboah
text: The LONG RANGE COMBAT round is skipped. One opposing Agent (your choice) is considered paralyzed and may not move or contribute to the Combat. The target Agent is still vulnerable to Aboah's attack. This Adversary may use SUBTERFUGE cards.

name: Scott Garrett
text: This Adversary can attack one Agent (your choice) and is then discarded. If Agent Pendrell is in the Investigating Team, then he takes the LRC damage instead of the selected Agent. Agents attacked by this Adversary must immediately discard all attached Keyword ALIEN Equipment.

name: Scott Ostelhoff
text: This card is free if the Site prerequisite is ALIEN INVESTIGATION. Any Witnesses contributing to the Site skill check are immediately discarded. This Adversary may use MARTIAL ARTS and SUBTERFUGE cards.

name: Search Warrant
text: Play this card to examine your opponent's hand. Your opponent must discard two cards from their hand (your choice).

name: Senator Sorenson
text: Force one Agent with the Keyword FBI (your choice, but excluding Fox Mulder and Alex Krycek), back to the Bureau immediately. The Agent may not leave the Bureau, requisition Equipment, or contribute their skills until either the controlling player pays 7 [RP] or reveals all the cards in their hand.

name: Serial Ovatypes
text: Discard one Witness card from your hand to apply a -2 modifier to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or SCIENCES skill check.

name: Sgt. Louis Frisch
text: Adds 2 to one Team's ALIEN INVESTIGATION or SUBTERFUGE skill check.

name: Sharon Graffia
text: Adds 1 to one Team's OBSERVATION skill check once per turn. When one of your Agents is the target of an abduction, Sharon Graffia is abducted instead. Discard this card and the abduction is negated.

name: She Had a Date
text: Play to change the Site Prerequisite from EVIDENCE COLLECTION to MEDICAL.

name: Sheriff Andy Taylor
text: Attach this Witness to a Team. Sheriff Taylor will add his skills to the appropriate skill check like an Agent, CI:1, CRC:1, LRC:2, and HEALTH:3. If his HEALTH is reduced to zero, or at any time there are no Agents in the Team, Taylor is removed from the game.

name: Sheriff Hamilton
text: Adds 3 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION or adds 2 to one Team's BEHAVIORAL skill check.

name: Sheriff Withers
text: Adds 1 to one Team's CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION skill check once per turn.

name: Shiv
text: Adds 1 to the Agent's CLOSE RANGE COMBAT skill. Discard this card to escape The Gulag and return to the Bureau (undamaged).

name: Skin-Cognito
text: Play to force the Investigating player to discard all Keyword COMPUTER and EVIDENCE COLLECTION cards in their hand. In addition, if Skinner is part of the Team investigating this Site, his SUBTERFUGE skill is permanently reduced by one. Place this card beneath Skinner as a reminder of his reduced skill.

name: Small Potatoes
text: Place this card beneath an opposing Agent (your choice) and place two tokens on the Agent. Remove a token during each of your opponent's Debriefing Phases. While in play, the Agent's skills (except HEALTH) become -1 and all Equipment is discarded. During your opponent's turn, you may deploy the Agent as desired and contribute (negatively) to an Investigating Team's skill checks. Discard this card when the last token is removed.

name: Soledad's Revenge
text: Subtract 4 from one Team's OCCULT INVESTIGATION or SCIENCES skill check.

name: Soul Bond Eternal
text: Attach this card to an Agent in the Field. You may place any Witnesses that modify skill checks under this card. No more than three cards may be under this card at any one time. Once per turn, you may play cards stored under this card for 1[RP] less. Discard this Resource and the cards under it when the card is negated or when the Agent's HEALTH is reduced to zero.

name: Spontaneous Combustion
text: Play this card when a Keyword HEALING Card is played on an opposing Agent. The Agent is instantly killed and removed from the game.

name: Suspect Booked
text: Play after negating an Adversary when no Combat was involved. If the Team makes a CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION 4+ skill check, place this card in your Bureau Section. You may discard this card during your Investigation Phase to add 2 to a Site skill check.

name: Symbol of Protection
text: Play on a Team investigating a Site with OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill as a prerequisite. As long as the Team can make an OCCULT INVESTIGATION skill check of 5+, no OCCULT Adversaries may be played on the Agents at this Site.

name: Temple of the Seven Stars, Apison, TN
The Cigarette-Smoking Man's Warning
text: Play after your opponent has identified your X-File's METHOD. While this card is in play, you (as the Directed Player) may play Keyword GOVERNMENT cards for free and your GOVERNMENT Adversaries may ignore activator requirements.

name: The Death Card
text: Play to add 4 [CP] to your pool immediately.

name: The Goal In Sight Again
text: Play this card after one of your Teams successfully investigates a Site with OBSERVATION skill as a prerequisite. Place this card in your Bureau. Discard this Resource to add 1 to an OBSERVATION skill check.

name: The Golem Exacts Revenge
text: The Golem is unaffected by Combat attacks. This Adversary will attack for two CLOSE RANGE COMBAT rounds and is then discarded.

name: The Grey-Haired Man
text: Any Witness RESOURCE cards in play are immediately discarded. The Grey-Haired Man may use MARTIAL ARTS and SUBTERFUGE cards. Damage caused by this Adversary during LONG RANGE COMBAT may be split among all opponents (Directed Player's choice).

name: The Mad Hatter
text: Play this card on a Team in the Field that plays a Witness. The Mad Hatter abducts the Witness and the Team must make a CRIMINAL INVESTIGATION 5+ skill check. If unsuccessful, the Site skill check is failed and the Witness is removed from the game. If the Team makes the skill check, this card is negated and removed from the game.

name: The Mulder Family Legacy
text: Play this card on a Team with Fox Mulder to search through your Bureau Deck and add one of the following cards to your hand: "Bill Mulder", "Mrs. Mulder", "Samantha Mulder", or "Samantha, Agrarian Clone". If you play the chosen card immediately, then you may do so for half cost (rounded up).

name: The Niemans
text: Adds 1 to one Team's OBSERVATION or SUBTERFUGE skill check, or play this card to negate the Bluff "You've Got a Tail".

name: The Peacock Brothers
text: Apply -1 to any Equipment cards attached to the Team that modify LONG RANGE COMBAT or CLOSE RANGE COMBAT. Damage caused by this Adversary may be split among all opponents (Directed Player's choice).

name: The Well-Manicured Man's Vendetta
text: Attach this card to a Witness RESOURCE. If at any time the Witness is negated or removed from the game, your opponent loses 5 [CP] and must discard all GOVERNMENT Adversaries in their deck.

name: Thoughtographs
text: Adds 1 to the Agent's EVIDENCE COLLECTION skill.

name: Trail Gone Cold
text: Play this card on a Site any time after your opponent has assigned Agents to the Site. Unless this card is negated, only Agents with an OBSERVATION skill of 1+ may contribute their skills to any checks occurring at this Site.

name: Trepanning Operative
text: This card does not initiate Combat. Choose one Agent on the opposing Team. Your opponent must flip over and discard the top card from their Bureau deck. If the card has a [CP] cost, the target Agent inflicts damage on another Agent equal to the cost of the card. If the card has a [RP] cost, the target Agent receives damage equal to the cost of the card. If the card has a [*P] cost, then no damage is applied and this card is discarded.

name: Trial Run
text: Play this card to add 2X [CP] to your pool. X = the number of Witnesses in your Discard Pile.

name: Tricks of the Trade
text: Show this card to your opponent to retrieve all Keyword RESOURCE cards from your Discard Pile. Shuffle them back into your Bureau Deck and discard this card.

name: U.F.O. Crash Site, Great Sacandaga Lake, NY
Uncanny Seduction
text: The cost of any PRIMORDIAL or EVOLUTIONARY Adversaries played at this Site is reduced by 2 for each female Agent on the Team.

name: Vassily Peskow
text: Vassily Peskow can attack one Agent (your choice) and is then discarded. If the target Agent has any Equipment cards that modify LRC or CRC, Peskow may steal that Equipment and use it in Combat. Discard the Equipment when combat is resolved. This Adversary may use MARTIAL ARTS and SUBTERFUGE cards.

name: Warning From the Future
text: Play this card on a Site card with COMPUTER or SCIENCES as a prerequisite. Immediately discard all Active and Conspiracy cards attached to the Site, along with the Site itself. The Case Assignment Phase starts over and the turn resumes as normal.

name: Wellhead Explosion
text: Force an opponent to remove one Keyword ARTIFACT card from the game.

name: Writing on the Wall
text: Attach this card to a Keyword MULTI Site to choose which prerequisite your opponent's Team must meet for this Site.

name: X-Terminated
text: Play this card to negate one Keyword NEGATE card. If "X" is the negated card, it is removed from the game along with this card.
